`services/content/bankStore.ts`:

```ts
// The on-device bank cache with a budget. It shares AsyncStorage with the learner's stats, so it keeps at
// most BANK_STORE.MAX_CACHED_BANKS cached non-bundled banks (Medium, Hard) and evicts the least recently used
// before writing one more; a stats write always has room. A bundled bank (Easy) is always in the app, so a
// cached copy of it is only a newer version: it never counts toward the cap and is never evicted. The index
// key records when each cached non-bundled bank was last written or played.
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type { CachedBank } from '@syntactical/content-schema';

import { logWarning } from '../../clients/logClient';
import { readJson } from '../../clients/readJson';
import { removeStoredKey } from '../../clients/removeStoredKey';
import { writeJson } from '../../clients/writeJson';
import { BANK_STORE, CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS } from '../../constants/contentCacheKeys';

import { buildBankCacheKey } from './buildBankCacheKey';
import { BUNDLED_BANKS } from './bundledBanks.generated';

type BankIndex = Record<string, number>;

function buildBankId(language: string, difficulty: string): string {
  return `${language}/${difficulty}`;
}

function isBundled(bankId: string): boolean {
  return Object.hasOwn(BUNDLED_BANKS, bankId);
}

async function readIndex(): Promise<BankIndex> {
  const stored = await readJson<unknown>(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.bankIndex, {});
  if (typeof stored !== 'object' || stored === null || Array.isArray(stored)) return {};
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(stored).filter((entry): entry is [string, number] => Number.isFinite(entry[1])),
  );
}

// The ids to evict, least recently used first, so that one more bank fits under the cap.
function pickEvictions(index: BankIndex, keepId: string): string[] {
  const others = Object.entries(index)
    .filter(([bankId]) => bankId !== keepId)
    .sort(([, left], [, right]) => left - right);
  const excess = others.length + 1 - BANK_STORE.MAX_CACHED_BANKS;
  return others.slice(0, Math.max(0, excess)).map(([bankId]) => bankId);
}

export async function writeStoredBank(
  language: string,
  difficulty: string,
  bank: CachedBank,
  now: number = Date.now(),
): Promise<boolean> {
  const bankId = buildBankId(language, difficulty);
  const key = buildBankCacheKey(language, difficulty);
  if (isBundled(bankId)) return writeJson(key, bank);
  const index = await readIndex();
  for (const evictedId of pickEvictions(index, bankId)) {
    const [evictedLanguage = '', evictedDifficulty = ''] = evictedId.split('/');
    await removeStoredKey(buildBankCacheKey(evictedLanguage, evictedDifficulty));
    delete index[evictedId];
  }
  const isWritten = await writeJson(key, bank);
  if (isWritten) index[bankId] = now;
  await writeJson(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.bankIndex, index);
  return isWritten;
}

export async function recordBankUse(language: string, difficulty: string, now: number = Date.now()): Promise<void> {
  const bankId = buildBankId(language, difficulty);
  if (isBundled(bankId)) return;
  const index = await readIndex();
  if (!Object.hasOwn(index, bankId)) return;
  index[bankId] = now;
  await writeJson(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.bankIndex, index);
}

export async function removeRetiredBankKeys(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const keys = await AsyncStorage.getAllKeys();
    const retired = keys.filter((key) => key.startsWith(CONTENT_CACHE_KEYS.retiredPaidBankPrefix));
    if (retired.length > 0) await AsyncStorage.multiRemove(retired);
  } catch (err) {
    logWarning({ err: String(err) }, 'retired bank cleanup failed');
  }
}
```

### Task 2.6: Reviews reach Medium and Hard banks downloaded this session or never opened on this device

Reviews are built from local banks only (`services/review/buildQuestionIndex.ts`). `services/content/readDownloadedBank.ts`:

```ts
// The newest copy of one bank downloaded this session, read from the TanStack Query cache (key
// ['bank', language, difficulty, hash]); null when none has downloaded yet.
import type { CachedBank } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import type { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

export function readDownloadedBank(queryClient: QueryClient, language: string, difficulty: string): CachedBank | null {
  const [newest] = queryClient
    .getQueryCache()
    .findAll({ queryKey: ['bank', language, difficulty] })
    .filter(({ state }) => state.data !== undefined)
    .sort((left, right) => right.state.dataUpdatedAt - left.state.dataUpdatedAt);
  return (newest?.state.data as CachedBank | undefined) ?? null;
}
```

```tsx
// A bank downloaded this session wins over the startup snapshot, so reviews and the prefetch see it without a
// restart; the snapshot wins over the bundle.
function buildContentAccess(
  hydrated: HydratedContent,
  contentBaseUrl: string | null,
  queryClient: QueryClient,
): ContentAccess {
  const { banks, manifest } = hydrated;
  return {
    baselineManifest: manifest,
    contentBaseUrl,
    readLocalBank: (language, difficulty) =>
      readDownloadedBank(queryClient, language, difficulty) ??
      banks.get(buildBankId(language, difficulty)) ??
      readBundledBank(language, difficulty),
  };
}

`services/review/listDueReviewBankKeys.ts`:

```ts
// The bank keys (`language/difficulty`) of every question review item due by `now`, replayed from the answer
// event log alone, so it needs no bank content. A misconception item names no bank; the questions that carry
// it are question items of their own.
import { buildReviewState } from '@syntactical/progress';
import type { AnswerEvent } from '@syntactical/progress';

export function listDueReviewBankKeys(events: readonly AnswerEvent[], now: Date): string[] {
  const { questions } = buildReviewState(events, () => undefined);
  const nowMs = now.getTime();
  const dueIds = new Set(
    Object.values(questions)
      .filter(({ card }) => card.due.getTime() <= nowMs)
      .map(({ id }) => id),
  );
  const bankKeys = events.filter(({ questionId }) => dueIds.has(questionId)).map(({ bankKey }) => bankKey);
  return [...new Set(bankKeys)].sort();
}
```

`services/content/prefetchReviewBanks.ts`:

```ts
// Downloads each named bank that the manifest lists and the device has no local copy of (cached, bundled, or
// downloaded this session), so due reviews from it are not skipped. Does nothing without a content base URL.
import type { Manifest } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import type { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { logWarning } from '../../clients/logClient';

import { buildBankQuery } from './buildBankQuery';
import { findBankEntry } from './findBankEntry';
import type { ContentAccess } from './types/ContentAccess';

export function prefetchReviewBanks(
  queryClient: QueryClient,
  manifest: Manifest,
  access: ContentAccess,
  bankKeys: readonly string[],
): void {
  if (access.contentBaseUrl === null) return;
  for (const bankKey of bankKeys) {
    const [language, difficulty] = bankKey.split('/');
    if (!language || !difficulty) continue;
    const entry = findBankEntry(manifest, language, difficulty);
    if (!entry || access.readLocalBank(language, difficulty)) continue;
    queryClient
      .prefetchQuery(buildBankQuery(queryClient, access, language, difficulty, entry))
      .catch((err: unknown) => logWarning({ document: entry.path, err }, 'review bank prefetch failed'));
  }
}
```

// Downloads the Medium and Hard banks the learner's due reviews come from when this device has no copy (a new
// device, a reinstall, or a bank the cache evicted), each time the event log or the coarse clock changes.
// Renders nothing.
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

import { prefetchReviewBanks } from '../services/content/prefetchReviewBanks';
import { listDueReviewBankKeys } from '../services/review/listDueReviewBankKeys';

import { useContentContext } from './ContentProvider';
import { useQuizStats } from './StatsProvider';
import { useCoarseNow } from './useCoarseNow';
import { useLanguageManifest } from './useLanguageManifest';

export function ReviewBankPrefetch() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const access = useContentContext();
  const manifest = useLanguageManifest();
  const { eventLog } = useQuizStats();
  const now = useCoarseNow();
  useEffect(() => {
    prefetchReviewBanks(queryClient, manifest, access, listDueReviewBankKeys(eventLog, new Date(now)));
  }, [access, eventLog, manifest, now, queryClient]);
  return null;
}
```

// server/src/__tests__/startServerPublicContent.integration.test.ts
// Area 2: the API starts from one public content directory holding every bank, with no
// PAID_CONTENT_DIR. The paid bank route is gone (404, not 401), and a Medium bank whose bytes do
// not match the manifest still refuses the start. Every secret is generated at run time.
import { createHash, randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

import { SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import { pino } from 'pino';
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, inject, it } from 'vitest';

import { startServer } from '../startServer.js';
import type { RunningServer } from '../startServer.js';

import { createMigratedDatabase } from './integration/createMigratedDatabase.js';
import { SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS } from './integration/skipDatabaseTests.js';

const SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const SECRET_BYTES = 24;
const HTTP_OK = 200;
const HTTP_NOT_FOUND = 404;
const DIFFICULTIES = ['easy', 'medium', 'hard'] as const;
const PROVENANCE = { isHumanReviewed: false, source: 'original', validation: { method: 'judged', status: 'pending' } };

function serializeBank(id: string): Buffer {
  const question = {
    answerIndex: 1,
    choices: [{ text: 'one' }, { text: 'two' }, { text: 'three' }],
    id,
    prompt: 'A prompt',
    provenance: PROVENANCE,
    query: { explanation: 'Because.', title: 'A rule' },
    type: 'mc',
  };
  return Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify({ questions: [question], schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION })}\n`, 'utf8');
}

function sha256Hex(bytes: Buffer): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
}

async function writeUnder(root: string, relativePath: string, bytes: Buffer | string): Promise<void> {
  const file = join(root, relativePath);
  await mkdir(dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(file, bytes);
}

// Every bank in the one public directory; the manifest carries no access or productId.
async function writePublicContent(contentDir: string): Promise<void> {
  const banks: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const difficulty of DIFFICULTIES) {
    const bytes = serializeBank(`fixture-${difficulty}-1`);
    const path = `python/${difficulty}.json`;
    await writeUnder(contentDir, path, bytes);
    banks[difficulty] = { contentVersion: 1, hash: sha256Hex(bytes), path, topicCounts: {} };
  }
  const language = {
    banks,
    glyph: 'PY',
    grammar: 'python',
    id: 'python',
    label: 'Python',
    misconceptions: [],
    tagline: 'Tagline.',
    topics: [],
  };
  await writeUnder(
    contentDir,
    'manifest.json',
    JSON.stringify({ languages: [language], schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION }),
  );
}

describe.skipIf(SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS)('startServer from public content only', () => {
  let database: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createMigratedDatabase>>;
  let contentDir: string;
  let running: RunningServer | undefined;
  const logger = pino({ level: 'silent' });

  function buildSource(): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
    return {
      ALLOWED_ORIGINS: 'https://syntactical.dev',
      CONTENT_DIR: contentDir,
      DATABASE_URL: database.databaseUrl,
      EMAIL_FROM: 'Syntactical <sign-in@syntactical.dev>',
      NODE_ENV: 'test',
      PORT: '0',
      RATE_LIMIT_KEY_SECRET: randomBytes(SECRET_BYTES).toString('hex'),
      RESEND_API_KEY: randomBytes(SECRET_BYTES).toString('hex'),
      REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH: randomBytes(SECRET_BYTES).toString('hex'),
    };
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    database = await createMigratedDatabase(inject('testDatabaseUrl'));
  }, SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await database?.drop();
  }, SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS);

  beforeEach(async () => {
    contentDir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'start-server-public-'));
  });

  afterEach(async () => {
    await running?.close();
    running = undefined;
    await rm(contentDir, { force: true, recursive: true });
  });

  it('starts with no PAID_CONTENT_DIR and answers /health/ready', async () => {
    await writePublicContent(contentDir);
    running = await startServer(buildSource(), { logger });

    const ready = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${running.port}/health/ready`);
    expect(ready.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
  });

  it('has no paid bank route', async () => {
    await writePublicContent(contentDir);
    running = await startServer(buildSource(), { logger });

    const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${running.port}/v1/banks/python/medium`);
    expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
  });

  it('refuses to start when a Medium bank does not match its manifest hash', async () => {
    await writePublicContent(contentDir);
    await writeUnder(
      contentDir,
      'python/medium.json',
      Buffer.concat([serializeBank('fixture-medium-1'), Buffer.from(' ')]),
    );

    await expect(startServer(buildSource(), { logger })).rejects.toThrow(/Bank hash mismatch: python\/medium\.json/);
  });
});

// server/src/__tests__/routes/askAllBanks.integration.test.ts
// Area 2: POST /v1/ask finds a Medium or Hard question in the index readServerQuestions builds from
// the one public content directory, and answers it for a user with any granted entitlement. There

// The model is a fake that records each prompt.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { mkdir, mkdtemp, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

import { SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, inject, it } from 'vitest';

import { readServerQuestions } from '../../services/readServerQuestions.js';
import { createFakeModelProvider } from '../../testing/fakeModelProvider.js';
import { createMigratedDatabase } from '../integration/createMigratedDatabase.js';
import { createTestApp } from '../integration/createTestApp.js';
import { insertSession } from '../integration/insertSession.js';
import { SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS } from '../integration/skipDatabaseTests.js';

const SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const ALLOWED_ORIGIN = 'https://syntactical.dev';
const ANY_PRODUCT = 'syntactical.go.medium';
const MESSAGE = 'Why is this the answer?';
const DIFFICULTIES = ['easy', 'medium', 'hard'] as const;
const PROVENANCE = { isHumanReviewed: true, source: 'original', validation: { method: 'judged', status: 'passed' } };

let database: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createMigratedDatabase>>;
let contentDir: string;

function serializeBank(difficulty: string): Buffer {
  const question = {
    answerIndex: 0,
    choices: [{ text: 'yes' }, { text: 'no' }],
    id: `fixture-${difficulty}-0`,
    prompt: 'Is this so?',
    provenance: PROVENANCE,
    query: { explanation: `${difficulty}-explanation-marker`, title: 'A rule' },
    type: 'mc',
  };
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ questions: [question], schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION }), 'utf8');
}

async function writeUnder(relativePath: string, bytes: Buffer | string): Promise<void> {
  const file = join(contentDir, relativePath);
  await mkdir(dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(file, bytes);
}

async function writePublicContent(): Promise<void> {
  const banks: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const difficulty of DIFFICULTIES) {
    const bytes = serializeBank(difficulty);
    const path = `python/${difficulty}.json`;
    await writeUnder(path, bytes);
    banks[difficulty] = {
      contentVersion: 1,
      hash: createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),
      path,
      topicCounts: {},
    };
  }
  const language = {
    banks,
    glyph: 'PY',
    grammar: 'python',
    id: 'python',
    label: 'Python',
    misconceptions: [],
    tagline: 'Tagline.',
    topics: [],
  };
  await writeUnder('manifest.json', JSON.stringify({ languages: [language], schemaVersion: SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION }));
}

async function signInEntitled() {
  const model = createFakeModelProvider();
  const questions = await readServerQuestions(contentDir);
  const { app, clock } = createTestApp({ ask: { modelProvider: model, questions }, pool: database.pool });
  const { sessionToken, userId } = await insertSession(database.pool, { createdAt: clock.now() });
  await database.pool.query('INSERT INTO entitlements (user_id, product_id, status, source) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)', [
    userId,
    ANY_PRODUCT,
    'granted',
    'test',
  ]);
  return { app, model, sessionToken };
}

  });

  it.each(['medium', 'hard'])('answers a %s question for a user with any granted entitlement', async (difficulty) => {
    const { app, model, sessionToken } = await signInEntitled();

    const response = await request(app)

      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${sessionToken}`)
      .set('Origin', ALLOWED_ORIGIN)
      .send({ bankKey: `python/${difficulty}`, message: MESSAGE, questionId: `fixture-${difficulty}-0` });

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(model.prompts[0]?.user).toContain(`${difficulty}-explanation-marker`);
  });
});

```ts
// Loads every bank's validated questions from the content directory's manifest and bank files,
// checked against the manifest hash. A bank the manifest lists but the directory lacks is skipped;
// the image build (copyContent.mjs) refuses to ship one.
import { buildBankContext, validateQuestionBank } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import type { BankEntry, LanguageEntry, Question } from '@syntactical/content-schema';

import type { QuestionIndex } from '../types/QuestionIndex.js';

import { readBankBytes } from './readBankBytes.js';
import { readManifest } from './readManifest.js';
import { sha256 } from './sha256.js';

async function readBank(
  contentDir: string,
  language: LanguageEntry,
  entry: BankEntry,
): Promise<Map<string, Question> | null> {
  const { hash, path } = entry;
  const bytes = await readBankBytes(contentDir, entry);
  if (bytes === null) return null;
  if (sha256(bytes).toString('hex') !== hash) {
    throw new Error(`Bank hash mismatch: ${path}`);
  }
  const validation = validateQuestionBank(JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8')) as unknown, buildBankContext(language));
  if ('rule' in validation) throw new Error(`Invalid bank ${path}: ${validation.rule}`);
  const { questions } = validation;
  return new Map(questions.map((question) => [question.id, question]));
}

async function readServerQuestions(contentDir: string): Promise<QuestionIndex> {
  const manifest = await readManifest(contentDir);
  const index = new Map<string, ReadonlyMap<string, Question>>();
  for (const language of manifest.languages) {
    const { banks, id } = language;
    for (const [difficulty, entry] of Object.entries(banks)) {
      const bank = await readBank(contentDir, language, entry);
      if (bank) index.set(`${id}/${difficulty}`, bank);
    }
  }
  return index;
}

export { readServerQuestions };
```

`server/src/services/readBankBytes.ts`:

```ts
// Reads one manifest bank's exact bytes from a root directory, refusing an unsafe path; null when
// the file is absent.
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';

import { isSafeBankPath } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import type { BankEntry } from '@syntactical/content-schema';

async function readBankBytes(root: string, { path }: BankEntry): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  if (!isSafeBankPath(path)) throw new Error(`Unsafe bank path: ${path}`);
  try {
    return await readFile(join(root, path));
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

export { readBankBytes };
```

```ts
// Pins that the clock createTestApp returns is the one every mounted session-guarded router
// reads (PR #186 review, r1 #1): a session live at the clock's start answers 200 on the admin and
// sync routes, and 401 on both once the clock advances past the idle TTL. The webhook router
// takes no clock, so it has nothing to pin here.
import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, inject, it } from 'vitest';

import { AUTH } from '../../constants/auth.js';
import { getAccess, signInUser } from './adminAccessRequests.js';
import { createMigratedDatabase } from './createMigratedDatabase.js';
import { createTestApp } from './createTestApp.js';
import { SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS } from './skipDatabaseTests.js';

const HTTP_OK = 200;
const HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED = 401;
const SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const ALLOWED_ORIGIN = 'https://syntactical.dev';
const PRODUCT_ID = 'syntactical.python.medium';
const ME_ROUTE = '/v1/me';

let database: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createMigratedDatabase>>;

describe.skipIf(SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS)('createTestApp clock', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    database = await createMigratedDatabase(inject('testDatabaseUrl'));
  }, SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await database.drop();
  });

  it('expires a session on every mounted session-guarded router once the clock advances', async () => {
    const paidProductIds: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([PRODUCT_ID]);
    const { app, clock } = createTestApp({
      admin: { paidProductIds },
      pool: database.pool,
      sync: { answerKey: new Map() },
    });
    const admin = await signInUser(database.pool, clock.now(), true);
    const getWithBearer = (path: string) =>
      request(app).get(path).set('Authorization', `Bearer ${admin.sessionToken}`).set('Origin', ALLOWED_ORIGIN);
    async function statuses(): Promise<{ admin: number; me: number }> {
      return {
        admin: (await getAccess(app, admin)).status,
        me: (await getWithBearer(ME_ROUTE)).status,
      };
    }

    const live = await statuses();
    clock.advance(AUTH.SESSION.IDLE_TTL_MS + DAY_MS);
    const expired = await statuses();

    expect(live).toEqual({ admin: HTTP_OK, me: HTTP_OK });
    expect(expired).toEqual({ admin: HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED, me: HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED });
  });
});
```

`src/__tests__/integration/createAdminTestApp.ts`, whole file:

```ts
// The app with the /v1/admin routes wired to a real database for one integration test, mounted
// beside the routes an admin grant must reach: the /v1 sync routes (GET /v1/me) and the
// RevenueCat webhook. One injectable clock serves every router, and the rate-limit key secret
// and webhook authorization value are generated at run time. The product ids handed to the admin
// and webhook routes are two legacy per-bank ids, as startServer passes LEGACY_PAID_PRODUCT_IDS.
import type pg from 'pg';

import { createTestApp } from './createTestApp.js';
import type { AnswerKey } from '../../types/AnswerKey.js';

export const ADMIN_TEST_PRODUCTS = {
  HARD: 'syntactical.python.hard',
  MEDIUM: 'syntactical.python.medium',
} as const;

interface AdminTestAppOptions {
  pool: pg.Pool;
}

export function createAdminTestApp(options: AdminTestAppOptions) {
  const { pool } = options;
  const paidProductIds: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(Object.values(ADMIN_TEST_PRODUCTS));
  const answerKey: AnswerKey = new Map();
  const { app, clock, rateLimitKeySecret, revenueCatAuth } = createTestApp({
    admin: { paidProductIds },
    pool,
    sync: { answerKey },
    webhooks: { paidProductIds },
  });
  return { app, clock, paidProductIds, rateLimitKeySecret, revenueCatAuth };
}
```

```ts
// Builds the content the e2e run serves: one public directory holding the repository's manifest and
// every bank it lists, Easy, Medium, and Hard, copied unchanged, so the web bundle's bundled Easy
// banks and the served manifest's hashes match. The API reads it and the web host serves it.
import { cp, mkdir, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

interface Manifest {
  languages: Array<{ banks: Record<string, { path: string }> }>;
}

async function copyUnder(contentSource: string, publicDir: string, path: string): Promise<void> {
  await mkdir(dirname(join(publicDir, path)), { recursive: true });
  await cp(join(contentSource, path), join(publicDir, path));
}

async function writeFixtureContent(options: { contentSource: string; publicDir: string }): Promise<void> {
  const { contentSource, publicDir } = options;
  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(contentSource, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')) as Manifest;
  for (const language of manifest.languages) {
    for (const { path } of Object.values(language.banks)) await copyUnder(contentSource, publicDir, path);
  }
  await copyUnder(contentSource, publicDir, 'manifest.json');
}

export { writeFixtureContent };
```

```ts
// copyContent.mjs gates what the API image ships: every bank the manifest lists must match its
// hash, a manifest path must stay inside the source, nothing the manifest does not name is copied,
// and the manifest itself is copied. stageBuildContent.sh stages build/content alone, from this
// repository's content or the CI fixture, and refuses the retired private mode.
import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { cpSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const serverDir = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../', import.meta.url));
const copyScript = join(serverDir, 'scripts', 'copyContent.mjs');
const stageScript = join(serverDir, 'scripts', 'stageBuildContent.sh');
const fixtureDir = join(serverDir, 'ci-fixture');

let work: string;

beforeEach(() => {
  work = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'copy-content-test-'));
});
afterEach(() => {
  rmSync(work, { force: true, recursive: true });
});

function sha256(text: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
}

function writeManifest(entries: Record<string, { hash: string; path: string }>): string {
  const manifestPath = join(work, 'manifest.json');
  writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify({ languages: [{ banks: entries }] }));
  return manifestPath;
}

function runCopy(manifestPath: string) {
  return spawnSync('node', [copyScript, manifestPath, join(work, 'from'), join(work, 'to')], { encoding: 'utf8' });
}

function writeSource(path: string, text: string): void {
  const file = join(work, 'from', path);
  mkdirSync(join(file, '..'), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(file, text);
}

function listFiles(dir: string): string[] {
  return readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((entry) => entry.isFile())
    .map((entry) => join(entry.parentPath, entry.name).slice(dir.length))
    .sort();
}

function copyStageInputs(): void {
  mkdirSync(join(work, 'server', 'scripts'), { recursive: true });
  cpSync(copyScript, join(work, 'server', 'scripts', 'copyContent.mjs'));
  cpSync(stageScript, join(work, 'server', 'scripts', 'stageBuildContent.sh'));
}

describe('copyContent.mjs', () => {
  it('copies every bank the manifest lists, Easy, Medium, and Hard, and the manifest', () => {
    writeSource('python/easy.json', '{"e":1}');
    writeSource('python/medium.json', '{"m":1}');
    writeSource('python/hard.json', '{"h":1}');
    const manifest = writeManifest({
      easy: { hash: sha256('{"e":1}'), path: 'python/easy.json' },
      hard: { hash: sha256('{"h":1}'), path: 'python/hard.json' },
      medium: { hash: sha256('{"m":1}'), path: 'python/medium.json' },
    });

    const result = runCopy(manifest);

    expect(result.status).toBe(0);
    expect(listFiles(join(work, 'to'))).toEqual([
      '/manifest.json',
      '/python/easy.json',
      '/python/hard.json',
      '/python/medium.json',
    ]);
  });

  it('fails naming a bank the manifest lists but the source lacks', () => {
    writeSource('python/easy.json', 'x');
    const manifest = writeManifest({
      easy: { hash: sha256('x'), path: 'python/easy.json' },
      medium: { hash: sha256('y'), path: 'python/medium.json' },
    });

    const result = runCopy(manifest);

    expect(result.status).toBe(1);
    expect(result.stderr).toContain('bank missing: python/medium.json');
  });

  it('fails with a hash mismatch when the bytes were tampered with', () => {
    writeSource('python/easy.json', '{"ok":2}');
    const manifest = writeManifest({ easy: { hash: sha256('{"ok":1}'), path: 'python/easy.json' } });

    const result = runCopy(manifest);

    expect(result.status).toBe(1);
    expect(result.stderr).toContain('hash mismatch');
    expect(existsSync(join(work, 'to', 'python', 'easy.json'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each(['../escape.json', '/etc/passwd', 'a/../../escape.json', 'a\\b.json'])(
    'rejects the manifest path %s',
    (path) => {
      writeSource('python/easy.json', 'x');
      const manifest = writeManifest({ easy: { hash: sha256('x'), path } });

      const result = runCopy(manifest);

      expect(result.status).toBe(1);
      expect(result.stderr).toContain('unsafe bank path');
    },
  );

  it('does not copy a file the manifest does not name', () => {
    writeSource('python/easy.json', 'x');
    writeSource('python/extra.json', 'not in the manifest');
    writeSource('.git/config', 'git internals');
    const manifest = writeManifest({ easy: { hash: sha256('x'), path: 'python/easy.json' } });

    const result = runCopy(manifest);

    expect(result.status).toBe(0);
    expect(readdirSync(join(work, 'to', 'python'))).toEqual(['easy.json']);
    expect(existsSync(join(work, 'to', '.git'))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('stageBuildContent.sh', () => {
  it('fixture: stages only the manifest-named files under build/content, and no paid-content', () => {
    // A temp copy of the scripts and the fixture, so the real build/ is never touched.
    copyStageInputs();
    cpSync(fixtureDir, join(work, 'server', 'ci-fixture'), { recursive: true });

    writeFileSync(join(work, 'server', 'ci-fixture', 'public', 'notes.txt'), 'not in the manifest');

    execFileSync('bash', [join(work, 'server', 'scripts', 'stageBuildContent.sh'), 'fixture'], { stdio: 'pipe' });

    expect(listFiles(join(work, 'build', 'content'))).toEqual([
      '/manifest.json',
      '/python/easy.json',
      '/python/medium.json',
    ]);
    expect(existsSync(join(work, 'build', 'paid-content'))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("public: stages this repository's content/ under build/content", () => {
    copyStageInputs();
    cpSync(join(fixtureDir, 'public'), join(work, 'content'), { recursive: true });

    execFileSync('bash', [join(work, 'server', 'scripts', 'stageBuildContent.sh'), 'public'], { stdio: 'pipe' });

    expect(listFiles(join(work, 'build', 'content'))).toEqual([
      '/manifest.json',
      '/python/easy.json',
      '/python/medium.json',
    ]);
  });

  it('refuses the retired private mode before touching anything', () => {
    copyStageInputs();

    const result = spawnSync('bash', [join(work, 'server', 'scripts', 'stageBuildContent.sh'), 'private'], {
      encoding: 'utf8',
      env: { ...process.env, CONTENT_DEPLOY_KEY: 'placeholder' },
    });

    expect(result.status).toBe(2);
    expect(result.stderr).toContain("unknown mode 'private'");
  });
});

**3a. Replace `server/scripts/copyContent.mjs`.**

```js
// Copies the manifest and every bank it lists, and nothing else, out of a content directory for the
// server image. Used by server/scripts/stageBuildContent.sh and server/Dockerfile.
//
//   node copyContent.mjs <manifest.json> <fromDir> <toDir>
//
// Every bank the manifest lists must exist under fromDir and match the manifest hash, or the build
// fails here rather than the server skipping it at startup. Files outside the manifest (a .git
// directory, notes, stray banks) are never copied.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { copyFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, posix } from 'node:path';

const [manifestPath, fromDir, toDir] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!manifestPath || !fromDir || !toDir) {
  console.error('usage: copyContent.mjs <manifest.json> <fromDir> <toDir>');
  process.exit(2);
}

function fail(message) {
  console.error(`copyContent: ${message}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

function isSafeRelativePath(path) {
  return (
    typeof path === 'string' &&
    path.length > 0 &&
    !path.startsWith('/') &&
    !path.includes('\\') &&
    posix.normalize(path) === path &&
    !path.split('/').includes('..')
  );
}

const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
const entries = manifest.languages.flatMap(({ banks }) => Object.values(banks));
if (entries.length === 0) {
  fail('the manifest lists no banks');
}

for (const { hash, path } of entries) {
  if (!isSafeRelativePath(path)) {
    fail(`unsafe bank path ${path}`);
  }
  let bytes;
  try {
    bytes = readFileSync(join(fromDir, path));
  } catch {
    fail(`bank missing: ${path}`);
  }
  if (createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex') !== hash) {
    fail(`bank hash mismatch: ${path}`);
  }
  const target = join(toDir, path);
  mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true });
  copyFileSync(join(fromDir, path), target);
}

mkdirSync(toDir, { recursive: true });
copyFileSync(manifestPath, join(toDir, 'manifest.json'));
console.log(`copyContent: copied ${entries.length} bank(s) and the manifest`);
```

**3b. Replace `server/scripts/stageBuildContent.sh`.**

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stages the content the API image bakes in, under <repo>/build/content, which server/Dockerfile
# copies. Every bank is public, so no key and no second repository are involved.
#
#   server/scripts/stageBuildContent.sh public    this repository's content/ (deploys and CI)
#   server/scripts/stageBuildContent.sh fixture   the tiny content set under server/ci-fixture/public
#
# Only the manifest and the banks it names are copied, each bank checked against its manifest hash.
set -euo pipefail

mode="${1:?usage: stageBuildContent.sh <public|fixture>}"
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
out="$root/build"
copy="$root/server/scripts/copyContent.mjs"

case "$mode" in
  public) source_dir="$root/content" ;;
  fixture) source_dir="$root/server/ci-fixture/public" ;;
  *)
    echo "stageBuildContent: unknown mode '$mode' (expected public or fixture)" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

rm -rf "${out:?}/content" "${out:?}/paid-content"
mkdir -p "$out"
node "$copy" "$source_dir/manifest.json" "$source_dir" "$out/content"
echo "stageBuildContent: staged $mode content under build/content"
```

`server/src/services/readServerQuestions.ts`, the whole file:

```ts
// Loads every bank's validated questions from the content directory's manifest and bank files,
// checked against the manifest hash. Every bank the manifest lists is required: a missing one
// refuses to load, so a misconfigured start fails loudly instead of dropping a bank's answers.
import { buildBankContext, validateQuestionBank } from '@syntactical/content-schema';
import type { BankEntry, LanguageEntry, Question } from '@syntactical/content-schema';

import type { QuestionIndex } from '../types/QuestionIndex.js';

import { readBankBytes } from './readBankBytes.js';
import { readManifest } from './readManifest.js';
import { sha256 } from './sha256.js';

async function readBank(contentDir: string, language: LanguageEntry, entry: BankEntry): Promise<Map<string, Question>> {
  const { hash, path } = entry;
  const bytes = await readBankBytes(contentDir, entry);
  if (bytes === null) throw new Error(`Bank missing: ${path}`);
  if (sha256(bytes).toString('hex') !== hash) {
    throw new Error(`Bank hash mismatch: ${path}`);
  }
  const validation = validateQuestionBank(JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8')) as unknown, buildBankContext(language));
  if ('rule' in validation) throw new Error(`Invalid bank ${path}: ${validation.rule}`);
  const { questions } = validation;
  return new Map(questions.map((question) => [question.id, question]));
}

async function readServerQuestions(contentDir: string): Promise<QuestionIndex> {
  const manifest = await readManifest(contentDir);
  const index = new Map<string, ReadonlyMap<string, Question>>();
  for (const language of manifest.languages) {
    const { banks, id } = language;
    for (const [difficulty, entry] of Object.entries(banks)) {
      index.set(`${id}/${difficulty}`, await readBank(contentDir, language, entry));
    }
  }
  return index;
}

export { readServerQuestions };
```

```ts
// Finds the first rule one manifest bank entry breaks, or null. Every bank is free, so `access` and
// `productId` are not checked: the free-banks contract step rejects them by name.
import { SHA256_HEX } from './SHA256_HEX.js';
import { CONTENT_LIMITS } from './contentLimits.js';
import { isRecord } from './isRecord.js';
import { isSafeBankPath } from './isSafeBankPath.js';

export function findBankEntryProblem(bank: unknown, topicIds: readonly string[]): string | null {
  if (!isRecord(bank)) return 'is not an object';

with

```ts
// Finds the first rule one manifest bank entry breaks, or null. Every bank is free, so the keys that once marked a
// paid bank are rejected by name before any other rule: a stale entry is reported for what is stale.
import { SHA256_HEX } from './SHA256_HEX.js';
import { CONTENT_LIMITS } from './contentLimits.js';
import { isRecord } from './isRecord.js';
import { isSafeBankPath } from './isSafeBankPath.js';

const RETIRED_KEYS = ['access', 'productId'] as const;

export function findBankEntryProblem(bank: unknown, topicIds: readonly string[]): string | null {
  if (!isRecord(bank)) return 'is not an object';
  const retiredKey = RETIRED_KEYS.find((key) => key in bank);
  if (retiredKey !== undefined) return `${retiredKey} is not allowed`;
  const { contentVersion, hash, path, topicCounts } = bank;
  if (typeof hash !== 'string' || !SHA256_HEX.test(hash)) return 'hash is invalid';
```

Assumed acceptable because area 3 replaces the gate with free and Pro limits.

3. **`check-api-image` always stages real content.** With no secret left, CI builds the image from the real `content/` (about 6.5 MB) instead of the fixture. `stageBuildContent.sh fixture` is kept for local checks and the script test. If CI time matters, the action could take a `content-source` input defaulting to `public`.
4. **The e2e fixture copies the real banks unchanged** from Task 2.7 on, instead of deriving five-question Medium and Hard banks. A Medium round in the e2e therefore has about 100 questions; `apiOutage` answers only one or two and leaves with Escape.
5. **What counts as a bank's use for eviction (Task 2.5).** Writing a bank (its first download or a refresh) and starting a round on it. Browsing a track's difficulty step does not count. The cap of 6 is about 2.4 MB at the sizes the spec gives; whether that is the right size for Android's AsyncStorage limit is unverified here (`node_modules` was not installed for the audit).
6. **A bank cached before Task 2.5 has no index entry.** No device has one in production, because Tasks 2.2 and 2.5 ship in the same PR. A development device that ran a build between them keeps such a bank outside the cap until it is refreshed; clearing the app's storage fixes it.
7. **Startup still reads every cached bank** (`ContentProvider`'s `readAllCachedBanks`), now at most six non-bundled ones plus refreshed Easy copies. Reading banks lazily per bank was proposed by the audit's modularization note and is not taken here; area 5's first task rewrites the provider's hydration and can take it up.
8. **Review prefetch traffic (Task 2.6).** A learner whose due reviews span more than six Medium and Hard banks will download, evict, and download again across sessions. Each download is one bank file from the static host; assumed acceptable.

// PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN (constants/appConfig.ts:45), restated here because the server never imports
// the app. normalizeProductId strips the base-plan suffix RevenueCat adds to a Google Play
// subscription's id (`<subscription id>:<base plan id>`) and leaves any other id as it is.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { normalizeProductId, PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST, PRO_PRODUCT_IDS } from '../../constants/proProducts.js';

const APP_PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN = /^syntactical\.[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z0-9-]+$/;

describe('PRO_PRODUCT_IDS', () => {
  it('names the annual and the lifetime product', () => {
    expect(PRO_PRODUCT_IDS).toEqual({ ANNUAL: 'syntactical.pro.annual', LIFETIME: 'syntactical.pro.lifetime' });
  });

  it('lists exactly those two ids', () => {
    expect([...PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST].sort()).toEqual(['syntactical.pro.annual', 'syntactical.pro.lifetime']);
  });

  it('gives ids that match the app product id pattern', () => {
    for (const id of PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST) {
      expect(id).toMatch(APP_PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN);
    }
  });
});

describe('normalizeProductId', () => {
  it('maps a Google Play subscription id with its base plan to the subscription id', () => {
    expect(normalizeProductId('syntactical.pro.annual:yearly')).toBe('syntactical.pro.annual');
  });

  it.each(['syntactical.pro.annual', 'syntactical.pro.lifetime', 'syntactical.cobol.full'])(
    'leaves the plain id %s unchanged',
    (productId) => {
      expect(normalizeProductId(productId)).toBe(productId);
    },
  );

  it.each([
    'syntactical.pro.annual:',
    ':yearly',
    'a:b:c',
    'syntactical.pro.annual:yearly:extra',
    'syntactical.pro.annual:Yearly',
    'syntactical.pro.annual:year ly',
  ])('leaves the malformed id %s unchanged', (productId) => {
    expect(normalizeProductId(productId)).toBe(productId);
  });
});

`server/src/constants/proProducts.ts`:

```ts
// The two Pro products (spec "2. Pro"): an auto-renewing annual subscription, whose entitlement row
// carries expires_at, and a lifetime non-consumable, whose row never expires. Both fit the app's
// PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN. The webhook, hasPro, the profile, and the admin toggle match these exactly.
// RevenueCat reports a Google Play subscription as `<subscription id>:<base plan id>` (the annual
// arrives as `syntactical.pro.annual:yearly`), so the webhook normalises an id before matching it.
const PRO_PRODUCT_IDS = {
  ANNUAL: 'syntactical.pro.annual',
  LIFETIME: 'syntactical.pro.lifetime',
} as const;

const PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST = [PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.ANNUAL, PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.LIFETIME] as const;

// Exactly one colon, a store id before it and a base plan id after it. Anything else is left as is.
const PLAY_BASE_PLAN_ID_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9.]+:[a-z0-9-]+$/;

type ProProductId = (typeof PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST)[number];

// The subscription id of a Play `<subscription id>:<base plan id>`; any other id unchanged.
function normalizeProductId(productId: string): string {
  if (!PLAY_BASE_PLAN_ID_PATTERN.test(productId)) {
    return productId;
  }
  return productId.slice(0, productId.indexOf(':'));
}

export { normalizeProductId, PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST, PRO_PRODUCT_IDS };
export type { ProProductId };
```

/**
 * When a Pro entitlement ends: the annual subscription's current period end, from RevenueCat's
 * expiration_at_ms. NULL for the lifetime product, for admin grants, and for rows written before
 * Pro. hasPro counts a granted row only while expires_at is NULL or later than now.
 *
 * @param {import('node-pg-migrate').MigrationBuilder} pgm
 */
export const up = (pgm) => {
  pgm.addColumn('entitlements', {
    expires_at: { type: 'timestamptz' },
  });
};

export const down = (pgm) => {
  pgm.dropColumn('entitlements', 'expires_at');
};

- Behaviour: the handler parses `revenueCatSchemas.eventType` first (400 `INPUT_INVALID_BODY` when the body has no event type). A type outside `HANDLED_TYPES` answers 200 `{ data: { status: 'ignored' } }` and records nothing, whatever else the event carries or lacks: RevenueCat leaves `product_id` or `app_user_id` out of some types, and a 400 would make it redeliver them forever. Only a handled type is validated against the full `revenueCatSchemas.webhook` (400 when it fails) and recorded. Later tasks change only `HANDLED_TYPES`, the handler's options (Task 3.4), and the dispatch inside it (Task 3.8).

```ts
// The RevenueCat event intake both webhook routes share: the JSON-only guard, and the handler.
// The handler reads the event type first with a minimal schema (400 when the body has none). A
// type outside HANDLED_TYPES answers 200 ignored without the full schema, because RevenueCat
// leaves the fields a purchase carries out of some types and would redeliver a 400 forever. Only a
// handled type is validated in full (400 when it is not a RevenueCat purchase event) and recorded
// once with its entitlement recomputed (recordPurchaseEvent) in one transaction. Authentication is
// the mounting router's job. The payload and the app user id are never logged.
import type { NextFunction, Request, RequestHandler, Response } from 'express';
import type { Logger } from 'pino';

import type { Database } from '../clients/database.js';
import { HTTP } from '../constants/http.js';
import { REVENUECAT_EVENTS } from '../constants/revenueCatEvents.js';
import { ERROR_CODES, sendError } from '../errors.js';
import { isJsonMediaType } from '../middleware/isJsonMediaType.js';
import { requestLog } from '../middleware/requestLogger.js';
import { revenueCatSchemas } from '../schemas/revenueCatSchemas.js';
import { recordPurchaseEvent } from '../services/recordPurchaseEvent.js';

const {
  STATUS: { BAD_REQUEST, OK, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE },
} = HTTP;

const { GRANT_TYPES, REVOKE_TYPES } = REVENUECAT_EVENTS;

const HANDLED_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([...GRANT_TYPES, ...REVOKE_TYPES]);

interface EventHandlerOptions {
  database: Database;
  logger: Logger;
}

function requireJsonBody(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
  if (isJsonMediaType(req.headers['content-type'])) {
    next();
    return;
  }
  sendError(
    res,
    UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,
    ERROR_CODES.INPUT.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,
    'Content-Type must be application/json',
  );
}

function sendInvalidBody(res: Response): void {
  sendError(res, BAD_REQUEST, ERROR_CODES.INPUT.INVALID_BODY, 'Invalid request body');
}

function createRevenueCatEventHandler(options: EventHandlerOptions): RequestHandler {
  const { database, logger } = options;
  return async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const typed = revenueCatSchemas.eventType.safeParse(req.body);
    if (!typed.success) {
      sendInvalidBody(res);
      return;
    }
    if (!HANDLED_TYPES.has(typed.data.event.type)) {
      res.status(OK).json({ data: { status: 'ignored' } });
      return;
    }
    const { data, success } = revenueCatSchemas.webhook.safeParse(req.body);
    if (!success) {
      sendInvalidBody(res);
      return;
    }
    const status = await recordPurchaseEvent({ database, event: data.event, logger: requestLog(res, logger) });
    res.status(OK).json({ data: { status } });
  };
}

export { createRevenueCatEventHandler, requireJsonBody };
```

`server/src/routes/revenueCatWebhook.ts`, replaced whole:

```ts
// POST /v1/webhooks/revenuecat (B-39a): authenticates by the Authorization header before the
// body is read (401 WEBHOOK_UNAUTHORIZED), then reads its own 64 KB JSON body: a Content-Type
// that is not application/json is 415, malformed or empty JSON is 400, over the limit is 413. A
// secret under 32 trimmed characters is refused when the router is built. What follows
// authentication is the shared intake (revenueCatEventHandler.ts): the event type is read first,
// an unhandled type is 200 ignored and recorded nowhere, a handled event that is not a RevenueCat
// purchase event is 400, and a handled event is recorded once and its entitlement recomputed
// (B-39b) in one transaction; a failure answers 500 so RevenueCat redelivers. The header, the
// payload, and the app user id are never logged.
import { timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';

import express, { Router } from 'express';
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from 'express';
import type { Logger } from 'pino';

import { HTTP } from '../constants/http.js';
import { WEBHOOKS } from '../constants/webhooks.js';
import { ERROR_CODES, sendError } from '../errors.js';
import { sha256 } from '../services/sha256.js';

import { createRevenueCatEventHandler, requireJsonBody } from './revenueCatEventHandler.js';
import type { WebhookDeps } from './webhookDeps.js';

const {
  STATUS: { UNAUTHORIZED },
} = HTTP;

const { BODY_LIMIT, MIN_AUTH_LENGTH } = WEBHOOKS;

function createRevenueCatWebhookRouter(deps: WebhookDeps, logger: Logger): Router {
  const { database, revenueCatAuth } = deps;
  if (revenueCatAuth.trim().length < MIN_AUTH_LENGTH) {
    throw new Error(`webhooks.revenueCatAuth must be at least ${MIN_AUTH_LENGTH} characters`);
  }
  const expectedDigest = sha256(revenueCatAuth);
  const router = Router();

  // Digests have equal length, so the compare takes the same time whatever the sent value.
  function requireWebhookAuth(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
    const sent = req.headers.authorization ?? '';
    if (timingSafeEqual(sha256(sent), expectedDigest)) {
      next();
      return;
    }
    sendError(res, UNAUTHORIZED, ERROR_CODES.WEBHOOK.UNAUTHORIZED, 'Unauthorized');
  }

  router.post(
    '/revenuecat',
    requireWebhookAuth,
    requireJsonBody,
    express.json({ limit: BODY_LIMIT }),
    createRevenueCatEventHandler({ database, logger }),
  );

  return router;
}

export { createRevenueCatWebhookRouter };
```

```ts
// Sandbox events: TestFlight and Play license-test purchases cost nothing, so on a server that does
// not accept sandbox (production: REVENUECAT_ACCEPT_SANDBOX unset) a SANDBOX event is recorded and
// answered 200 recorded but changes no entitlement, then or when a later event recomputes the row,
// and one warning names the event type and the reason, never the user. A server that accepts
// sandbox (staging) applies it. An event from any other environment, or with none (the app's
// fixture store sends none), is applied either way.
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, inject, it } from 'vitest';

import { createMigratedDatabase } from '../integration/createMigratedDatabase.js';
import { createWebhookTestApp } from '../integration/createWebhookTestApp.js';
import { SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS } from '../integration/skipDatabaseTests.js';

const ROUTE = '/v1/webhooks/revenuecat';
const HTTP_OK = 200;
const SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const DISTINCTIVE_BYTES = 12;
const T0 = 1_790_000_000_000;
const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
const PINO_WARN_LEVEL = 40;
const LIFETIME = 'syntactical.pro.lifetime';

let database: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createMigratedDatabase>>;

type TestApp = ReturnType<typeof createWebhookTestApp>;

async function insertUser(): Promise<string> {
  const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ id: string }>('INSERT INTO users (email) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id', [
    `learner-${randomUUID()}@example.com`,
  ]);
  return rows[0].id;
}

// A lifetime purchase from the App Store with no environment, unless overridden.
function deliver(testApp: TestApp, userId: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  const event = {
    app_user_id: userId,
    event_timestamp_ms: T0,
    id: randomUUID(),
    product_id: LIFETIME,
    store: 'APP_STORE',
    transaction_id: randomBytes(DISTINCTIVE_BYTES).toString('hex'),
    type: 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE',
    ...overrides,
  };
  return request(testApp.app)
    .post(ROUTE)
    .set('Authorization', testApp.revenueCatAuth)
    .set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    .send(JSON.stringify({ event }));
}

async function statusOf(userId: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ status: string }>(
    'SELECT status FROM entitlements WHERE user_id = $1 AND product_id = $2',
    [userId, LIFETIME],
  );
  return rows[0]?.status;
}

async function countPurchaseEvents(): Promise<number> {
  const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ count: string }>('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_events');
  return Number(rows[0].count);
}

function flushLogs(): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setImmediate(resolve);
  });
}

describe.skipIf(SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS)('POST /v1/webhooks/revenuecat SANDBOX events', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    database = await createMigratedDatabase(inject('testDatabaseUrl'));
  }, SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await database?.drop();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await database.reset();
  });

  it('records a SANDBOX purchase on a server that does not accept sandbox, grants nothing, and warns once', async () => {
    const testApp = createWebhookTestApp({ acceptSandbox: false, pool: database.pool });
    const userId = await insertUser();

    const response = await deliver(testApp, userId, { environment: 'SANDBOX' });
    await flushLogs();

    expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
    expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(1);
    expect(await statusOf(userId)).toBeUndefined();
    const warnings = testApp.logLines
      .map((line) => JSON.parse(line) as Record<string, unknown>)
      .filter(({ reason }) => reason === 'sandbox');
    expect(warnings).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(warnings[0]).toMatchObject({ eventType: 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE', level: PINO_WARN_LEVEL });
    expect(testApp.logLines.join('\n')).not.toContain(userId);
  });

  it('never applies a recorded SANDBOX grant when a later production event recomputes the row', async () => {
    const testApp = createWebhookTestApp({ acceptSandbox: false, pool: database.pool });
    const userId = await insertUser();

    await deliver(testApp, userId, { environment: 'SANDBOX', event_timestamp_ms: T0 + HOUR_MS });
    await deliver(testApp, userId, { environment: 'PRODUCTION', type: 'REFUND' });

    expect(await statusOf(userId)).toBe('revoked');
  });

  it.each([
    ['PRODUCTION', { environment: 'PRODUCTION' }],
    ['no environment', {}],
  ])('applies a purchase with %s on a server that does not accept sandbox', async (_label, overrides) => {
    const testApp = createWebhookTestApp({ acceptSandbox: false, pool: database.pool });
    const userId = await insertUser();

    await deliver(testApp, userId, overrides);

    expect(await statusOf(userId)).toBe('granted');
  });

  it('applies a SANDBOX purchase on a server that accepts sandbox, as staging does', async () => {
    const testApp = createWebhookTestApp({ acceptSandbox: true, pool: database.pool });
    const userId = await insertUser();

    await deliver(testApp, userId, { environment: 'SANDBOX' });

    expect(await statusOf(userId)).toBe('granted');
  });
});

Webhook body: `event.expiration_at_ms?: number` (integer, 0 to `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`), anything else 400 `INPUT_INVALID_BODY`.

The per-product rules live only here: `recomputeEntitlement` reads `cancellation` (this task) and `requiresExpiry` (Task 3.6), and `recordPurchaseEvent` reads `requiresExpiry` (Task 3.6).

- Behaviour: `HANDLED_TYPES` = grant, revoke, and expiry-only types; any other type is 200 `{ data: { status: 'ignored' } }` and records nothing (`TRANSFER` joins the handled set in Task 3.8). What revokes: a `REVOKE_TYPES` event on either product; a `CANCELLATION` on a product whose rule is `cancellation: 'revoke'` (the lifetime); and a `CANCELLATION` whose stored `cancel_reason` is `CUSTOMER_SUPPORT` on either product, because that is how RevenueCat reports a store refund. `REFUND` stays in `REVOKE_TYPES` in case RevenueCat sends it. // Pro webhook vocabulary (spec "2. Pro", Server): INITIAL_PURCHASE, RENEWAL, UNCANCELLATION, and
// NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE grant; EXPIRATION and REFUND revoke; CANCELLATION revokes the lifetime
// product but leaves an annual grant in force (auto-renew off, access continues), unless its
// cancel_reason is CUSTOMER_SUPPORT, a store refund, which revokes either product;
// SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED never changes the status; any other type answers 200 ignored and records
// nothing. Only the two Pro product ids change an entitlement.
// expiration_at_ms, when sent, is a non-negative safe integer kept in the stored payload; any other
// value is refused with 400 and records nothing. A Google Play id with its base plan
// (syntactical.pro.annual:yearly) is the annual product.
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import request from 'supertest';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, inject, it } from 'vitest';

import { createMigratedDatabase } from '../integration/createMigratedDatabase.js';
import { createWebhookTestApp } from '../integration/createWebhookTestApp.js';
import { SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS } from '../integration/skipDatabaseTests.js';

const ROUTE = '/v1/webhooks/revenuecat';
const HTTP_OK = 200;
const HTTP_BAD_REQUEST = 400;
const SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;
const DISTINCTIVE_BYTES = 12;
const BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS = 1_790_000_000_000;
const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
const YEAR_MS = 31_536_000_000;
const ANNUAL = 'syntactical.pro.annual';
const LIFETIME = 'syntactical.pro.lifetime';
const UNKNOWN_PRODUCT = 'syntactical.pro.monthly';
// How RevenueCat reports the annual subscription bought on Google Play: `<subscription id>:<base plan id>`.
const PLAY_ANNUAL = 'syntactical.pro.annual:yearly';

let database: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createMigratedDatabase>>;

type TestApp = ReturnType<typeof createWebhookTestApp>['app'];

interface Target {
  app: TestApp;
  revenueCatAuth: string;
  userId: string;
}

// An annual INITIAL_PURCHASE from the App Store with a one-year period, unless overridden.
function buildEvent(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    app_user_id: randomUUID(),
    environment: 'SANDBOX',
    event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS,
    expiration_at_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + YEAR_MS,
    id: randomUUID(),
    product_id: ANNUAL,
    store: 'APP_STORE',
    transaction_id: randomBytes(DISTINCTIVE_BYTES).toString('hex'),
    type: 'INITIAL_PURCHASE',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

// The lifetime product has no period: its events carry no expiration_at_ms.
function lifetime(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { expiration_at_ms: undefined, product_id: LIFETIME, type: 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE', ...overrides };
}

async function insertUser(): Promise<string> {
  const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ id: string }>('INSERT INTO users (email) VALUES ($1) RETURNING id', [
    `learner-${randomUUID()}@example.com`,
  ]);
  return rows[0].id;
}

async function setup(): Promise<Target> {
  const { app, revenueCatAuth } = createWebhookTestApp({ pool: database.pool });
  return { app, revenueCatAuth, userId: await insertUser() };
}

function deliver(target: Target, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return request(target.app)
    .post(ROUTE)
    .set('Authorization', target.revenueCatAuth)
    .set('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    .send(JSON.stringify({ event: buildEvent({ app_user_id: target.userId, ...overrides }) }));
}

// The (user, product) status, or undefined when no row exists. Every row here is RevenueCat's.
async function statusOf(userId: string, productId: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ source: string; status: string }>(
    'SELECT status, source FROM entitlements WHERE user_id = $1 AND product_id = $2',
    [userId, productId],
  );
  if (rows[0]) {
    expect(rows[0].source).toBe('revenuecat');
  }
  return rows[0]?.status;
}

async function countPurchaseEvents(): Promise<number> {
  const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ count: string }>('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM purchase_events');
  return Number(rows[0].count);
}

describe.skipIf(SKIP_DATABASE_TESTS)('POST /v1/webhooks/revenuecat Pro event vocabulary', () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    database = await createMigratedDatabase(inject('testDatabaseUrl'));
  }, SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS);

  afterAll(async () => {
    await database?.drop();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await database.reset();
  });

  describe('grants', () => {
    it.each(['INITIAL_PURCHASE', 'RENEWAL', 'UNCANCELLATION'])(
      '%s on the annual product answers 200 recorded and grants only the annual row',
      async (type) => {
        const target = await setup();

        const response = await deliver(target, { type });

        expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
        expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
        expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBe('granted');
        expect(await statusOf(target.userId, LIFETIME)).toBeUndefined();
      },
    );

    it('NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE on the lifetime product grants only the lifetime row', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      const response = await deliver(target, lifetime());

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, LIFETIME)).toBe('granted');
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  describe('revokes', () => {
    it('EXPIRATION after an annual grant revokes it', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      await deliver(target);
      const response = await deliver(target, {
        event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + YEAR_MS,
        type: 'EXPIRATION',
      });

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBe('revoked');
    });

    it.each([
      [ANNUAL, {}],
      [LIFETIME, lifetime()],
    ])('REFUND after a grant revokes %s', async (productId, grant) => {
      const target = await setup();

      await deliver(target, grant);
      const response = await deliver(target, {
        ...grant,
        event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + HOUR_MS,
        product_id: productId,
        type: 'REFUND',
      });

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, productId)).toBe('revoked');
    });

    it.each([
      [ANNUAL, {}],
      [LIFETIME, lifetime()],
    ])(
      'CANCELLATION with cancel_reason CUSTOMER_SUPPORT (a store refund) after a grant revokes %s',
      async (productId, grant) => {
        const target = await setup();

        await deliver(target, grant);
        const response = await deliver(target, {
          ...grant,
          cancel_reason: 'CUSTOMER_SUPPORT',
          event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + HOUR_MS,
          product_id: productId,
          type: 'CANCELLATION',
        });

        expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
        expect(await statusOf(target.userId, productId)).toBe('revoked');
      },
    );
  });

  describe('CANCELLATION', () => {
    it('leaves an annual grant in force: auto-renew is off and access continues', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      await deliver(target);
      const response = await deliver(target, {
        cancel_reason: 'UNSUBSCRIBE',
        event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + HOUR_MS,
        type: 'CANCELLATION',
      });

      expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(2);
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBe('granted');
    });

    it('revokes a lifetime grant, as before Pro', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      await deliver(target, lifetime());
      const response = await deliver(
        target,
        lifetime({ event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + HOUR_MS, type: 'CANCELLATION' }),
      );

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, LIFETIME)).toBe('revoked');
    });

    it('on the annual product with no grant recorded, records the event and creates no row', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      const response = await deliver(target, { type: 'CANCELLATION' });

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(1);
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  describe('SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED', () => {
    it('keeps an annual grant in force and records the event', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      await deliver(target);
      const response = await deliver(target, {
        event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + HOUR_MS,
        expiration_at_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + 2 * YEAR_MS,
        type: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED',
      });

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(2);
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBe('granted');
    });

    it('with no grant recorded, records the event and creates no row', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      const response = await deliver(target, { type: 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED' });

      expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
      expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(1);
      expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });

  describe('types the server does not handle', () => {
    // TRANSFER is handled from Task 3.8; BILLING_ISSUE stays ignored (the grace-period gap the
    // runbook records as accepted).
    it.each(['BILLING_ISSUE', 'PRODUCT_CHANGE', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED', 'SUBSCRIBER_ALIAS', 'TEST'])(
      'answers %s with 200 ignored, records nothing, and leaves an annual grant unchanged',
      async (type) => {
        const target = await setup();

        await deliver(target);
        const response = await deliver(target, { event_timestamp_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + HOUR_MS, type });

        expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
        expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'ignored' } });
        expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(1);
        expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBe('granted');
      },
    );
  });

  it('records a grant for a product id that is not Pro and grants nothing', async () => {
    const target = await setup();

    const response = await deliver(target, { product_id: UNKNOWN_PRODUCT });

    expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
    expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(1);
    const { rows } = await database.pool.query('SELECT 1 FROM entitlements WHERE user_id = $1', [target.userId]);
    expect(rows).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('grants the annual for a Google Play id with its base plan and stores the normalised id', async () => {
    const target = await setup();

    const response = await deliver(target, { product_id: PLAY_ANNUAL, store: 'PLAY_STORE' });

    expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_OK);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ data: { status: 'recorded' } });
    expect(await statusOf(target.userId, ANNUAL)).toBe('granted');
    const { rows: entitlementProducts } = await database.pool.query<{ product_id: string }>(
      'SELECT product_id FROM entitlements WHERE user_id = $1',
      [target.userId],
    );
    expect(entitlementProducts).toEqual([{ product_id: ANNUAL }]);
    const { rows: events } = await database.pool.query<{ payload_product_id: string; product_id: string }>(
      "SELECT product_id, payload->>'product_id' AS payload_product_id FROM purchase_events",
    );
    expect(events).toEqual([{ payload_product_id: PLAY_ANNUAL, product_id: ANNUAL }]);
  });

  describe('expiration_at_ms', () => {
    it('keeps a sent expiration_at_ms in the stored payload', async () => {
      const target = await setup();

      await deliver(target, { expiration_at_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + YEAR_MS });

      const { rows } = await database.pool.query<{ payload: Record<string, unknown> }>(
        'SELECT payload FROM purchase_events',
      );
      expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(rows[0].payload).toMatchObject({
        expiration_at_ms: BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS + YEAR_MS,
        product_id: ANNUAL,
        type: 'INITIAL_PURCHASE',
      });
    });

    it.each([
      ['a negative number', -1],
      ['a fraction', 1.5],
      ['a numeric string', String(BASE_TIMESTAMP_MS)],
      ['null', null],
      ['an integer past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER', Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 2],
    ])('refuses %s with 400 INPUT_INVALID_BODY and records nothing', async (_label, value) => {
      const target = await setup();

      const response = await deliver(target, lifetime({ expiration_at_ms: value }));

      expect(response.status).toBe(HTTP_BAD_REQUEST);
      expect(response.body.error.code).toBe('INPUT_INVALID_BODY');
      expect(await countPurchaseEvents()).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});
```

// RevenueCat event vocabulary (spec "2. Pro", Server): which event types grant or revoke a Pro
// entitlement, which only carry a new expiry, which stores may change an entitlement, the provider
// name stored on purchase_events, and the payload allowlist. CANCELLATION is listed as expiry-only;
// whether it revokes instead depends on the product and on cancel_reason (PRO_PRODUCT_RULES and
// PRO_REFUND_CANCEL_REASON in proProducts.ts), which recomputeEntitlement applies. Any other type
// is answered 200 ignored.
const REVENUECAT_EVENTS = {
  CANCELLATION_TYPE: 'CANCELLATION',
  ENTITLEMENT_SOURCE: 'revenuecat',
  EXPIRY_ONLY_TYPES: ['CANCELLATION', 'SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED'],
  GRANT_TYPES: ['INITIAL_PURCHASE', 'RENEWAL', 'UNCANCELLATION', 'NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE'],
  PAYLOAD_KEYS: [
    'type',
    'store',
    'environment',
    'product_id',
    'event_timestamp_ms',
    'purchased_at_ms',
    'expiration_at_ms',
    'transaction_id',
    'original_transaction_id',
    'price',
    'currency',
    'cancel_reason',
    'period_type',
  ],
  PROVIDER: 'revenuecat',
  // REFUND is kept in case RevenueCat sends it; a store refund arrives as a CUSTOMER_SUPPORT CANCELLATION.
  REVOKE_TYPES: ['EXPIRATION', 'REFUND'],
  // The environment RevenueCat stamps on a free test purchase (Task 3.4).
  SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT: 'SANDBOX',
  STORES: ['APP_STORE', 'PLAY_STORE', 'RC_BILLING'],
} as const;

export { REVENUECAT_EVENTS };
```

`buildPayload` in `recordPurchaseEvent.ts` iterates `PAYLOAD_KEYS`, so `expiration_at_ms` reaches the stored payload with no change there, and `cancel_reason` already does.

  // How each Pro product treats the events that end or extend access. The only place these
  // per-product rules live: recomputeEntitlement and recordPurchaseEvent read them.
  interface ProProductRule {
    // What a CANCELLATION does: 'expiry' only moves expires_at (auto-renew off, access continues to
    // the period end); 'revoke' ends access.
    cancellation: 'expiry' | 'revoke';
    // Whether a grant counts only when it carries expiration_at_ms. Fail closed: a period product
    // must never become Pro forever.
    requiresExpiry: boolean;
  }

  const PRO_PRODUCT_RULES: Readonly<Record<ProProductId, ProProductRule>> = {
    [PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.ANNUAL]: { cancellation: 'expiry', requiresExpiry: true },
    [PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.LIFETIME]: { cancellation: 'revoke', requiresExpiry: false },
  };

  // RevenueCat reports a store refund as a CANCELLATION with this cancel_reason. It revokes either
  // product, whatever the product's cancellation rule.
  const PRO_REFUND_CANCEL_REASON = 'CUSTOMER_SUPPORT';

  function isProProductId(productId: string): productId is ProProductId {
    return (PRO_PRODUCT_ID_LIST as readonly string[]).includes(productId);
  }
  ```

`server/src/services/recomputeEntitlement.ts`, replaced whole (status only; Task 3.6 adds the expiry):

```ts
// Sets the (user, Pro product) entitlement from the purchase events of the stores that can change
// it: the latest grant or revoke event by occurred_at wins, a revoke winning a tie. What revokes
// comes from the product's rule (PRO_PRODUCT_RULES): a REVOKE_TYPES event always; a CANCELLATION
// when the product's cancellation is 'revoke' (the lifetime product); and, on either product, a
// CANCELLATION whose cancel_reason is PRO_REFUND_CANCEL_REASON, which is how RevenueCat reports a
// store refund. Every other expiry-only event (an annual CANCELLATION with auto-renew turned off,
// a SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED) never changes the status and never creates a row. The row is written
// with source 'revenuecat' only when the status differs, so a redelivery leaves updated_at
// untouched. Callers hold the (user, product) advisory lock so the read sees every committed event.
import type pg from 'pg';

import { PRO_PRODUCT_RULES, PRO_REFUND_CANCEL_REASON } from '../constants/proProducts.js';
import type { ProProductId } from '../constants/proProducts.js';
import { REVENUECAT_EVENTS } from '../constants/revenueCatEvents.js';

const { CANCELLATION_TYPE, ENTITLEMENT_SOURCE, GRANT_TYPES, PROVIDER, REVOKE_TYPES, SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT, STORES } =
  REVENUECAT_EVENTS;

type Status = 'granted' | 'revoked';

// One product's events from the stores that can change it, each marked with whether it revokes;
// SANDBOX events only when the server accepts them (Task 3.4). $1 user, $2 product, $3 provider,
// $4 stores, $5 revoke types, $6 CANCELLATION, $7 whether a CANCELLATION revokes on this product,
// $8 the refund cancel_reason, $9 acceptSandbox, $10 SANDBOX. A constant, never user input.
const EVENTS_SQL = `SELECT kind, occurred_at, payload,
    (kind = ANY($5::text[])
      OR (kind = $6 AND ($7::boolean OR payload->>'cancel_reason' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $8::text))) AS is_revoke
  FROM purchase_events
  WHERE provider = $3 AND user_id = $1 AND product_id = $2 AND payload->>'store' = ANY($4::text[])
    AND ($9::boolean OR payload->>'environment' IS DISTINCT FROM $10::text)`;

function eventParams(userId: string, productId: ProProductId, acceptSandbox: boolean): unknown[] {
  return [
    userId,
    productId,
    PROVIDER,
    [...STORES],
    [...REVOKE_TYPES],
    CANCELLATION_TYPE,
    PRO_PRODUCT_RULES[productId].cancellation === 'revoke',
    PRO_REFUND_CANCEL_REASON,
    acceptSandbox,
    SANDBOX_ENVIRONMENT,
  ];
}

async function readStatus(
  client: pg.PoolClient,
  userId: string,
  productId: ProProductId,
  acceptSandbox: boolean,
): Promise<Status | undefined> {
  const { rows } = await client.query<{ status: Status }>(
    `WITH events AS (${EVENTS_SQL})
     SELECT CASE WHEN is_revoke THEN 'revoked' ELSE 'granted' END AS status
     FROM events
     WHERE is_revoke OR kind = ANY($11::text[])
     ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, is_revoke DESC
     LIMIT 1`,
    [...eventParams(userId, productId, acceptSandbox), [...GRANT_TYPES]],
  );
  return rows[0]?.status;
}

async function recomputeEntitlement(
  client: pg.PoolClient,
  userId: string,
  productId: ProProductId,
  acceptSandbox: boolean,
): Promise<void> {
  const status = await readStatus(client, userId, productId, acceptSandbox);
  if (!status) {
    return;
  }
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO entitlements (user_id, product_id, source, status)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
     ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET source = EXCLUDED.source, status = EXCLUDED.status
     WHERE entitlements.status IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.status
        OR entitlements.source IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source`,
    [userId, productId, ENTITLEMENT_SOURCE, status],
  );
}

export { recomputeEntitlement };
```

`IS NOT DISTINCT FROM` makes a CANCELLATION with no `cancel_reason` read as not a refund, never as NULL.

- Behaviour: while the row is `granted`, `expires_at` is `to_timestamp(expiration_at_ms / 1000)` of the latest grant or expiry-only event by `occurred_at` that does not revoke (on the annual: a grant, a non-refund `CANCELLATION`, or a `SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED`); a lifetime `NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE` carries none, so the lifetime row keeps `expires_at` NULL. A revoke, a refund `CANCELLATION` included, leaves `expires_at` as it was.
- Both rules read `PRO_PRODUCT_RULES[productId].requiresExpiry` (Task 3.5); no service compares a product id with the annual id.
- Fail closed on a product whose rule has `requiresExpiry` (the annual): a grant event (`INITIAL_PURCHASE`, `RENEWAL`, `UNCANCELLATION`, or any other grant type) on `syntactical.pro.annual` with no `expiration_at_ms` is recorded in `purchase_events` as usual (idempotency unchanged) and answered 200 `recorded`, but `recomputeEntitlement` ignores it for status and expiry, and `recordPurchaseEvent` logs one `warn` `{ productId, type }` with the message `annual grant without expiration ignored`. Annual events without `expiration_at_ms` are also skipped when picking the expiry, so a granted annual row never has a NULL `expires_at` (which would mean Pro forever). An expiry-only event never changes `status` and never creates a row. The `(user_id, product_id)` key keeps the annual and lifetime rows apart (Review Focus 1). A `RENEWAL` older than a recorded `EXPIRATION` neither re-grants nor moves `expires_at` (Review Focus 2).
