```tsx
// components/purchase/__tests__/ProSheet.web.test.tsx
// The Pro sheet on the web: an aria-modal dialog named "Syntactical Pro" with exactly one h1 and no
// axe violations (color-contrast off: jsdom computes no colors; Lighthouse covers it); focus moves
// into it, Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside it, and it stays inside while a purchase runs; Escape
// closes it; it slides in unless motion is reduced; quiz keys are inert while it is open; and with
// no prices and no Web Billing key it says Pro is in the mobile apps instead of offering buttons.
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';

import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import { axe, toHaveNoViolations } from 'jest-axe';

import { setExpoExtra } from '../../../config/expoConstantsMock';
import { isModalOpen } from '../../../state/modalOpenSignal';
import { ProSheet } from '../ProSheet';

expect.extend(toHaveNoViolations);

const mockMotion = { isReduced: false };
jest.mock('../../../state/useIsReducedMotion', () => ({ useIsReducedMotion: () => mockMotion.isReduced }));
jest.mock('../../../clients/analyticsClient', () => ({ trackEvent: jest.fn() }));

const AXE_OPTIONS = { rules: { 'color-contrast': { enabled: false } } };
const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
const PRICES = { 'syntactical.pro.annual': '£17.49', 'syntactical.pro.lifetime': '£34.99' };
const WEB_UNAVAILABLE = 'Pro is available in the iOS and Android apps for now.';

// Built at run time so no credential-shaped literal sits in source.
function buildWebBillingKey(): string {
  return `rcb_${randomBytes(12).toString('hex')}`;
}

function buildProps(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    isBuying: false,
    message: null,
    onBuy: jest.fn(),
    onClose: jest.fn(),
    prices: PRICES,
    source: 'settings' as const,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function listFocusable(dialog: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[] {
  return Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE)).filter(
    (element) => element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true',
  );
}

function readPanelStyle(): CSSStyleDeclaration {
  return screen.getByTestId('pro-sheet-panel').style;
}

function isSliding(style: CSSStyleDeclaration): boolean {
  const animationName = style.animationName || style.animation;
  return animationName !== '' && !/^none/.test(animationName);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  mockMotion.isReduced = false;
  setExpoExtra({ apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.syntactical.dev/v1/', revenueCatWebBillingKey: buildWebBillingKey() });
});

describe('ProSheet on the web', () => {
  it('is an aria-modal dialog named "Syntactical Pro" with one h1 and no axe violations', async () => {
    const { container } = render(<ProSheet {...buildProps()} />);
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Syntactical Pro' });
    expect(dialog.getAttribute('aria-modal')).toBe('true');
    expect(within(dialog).getAllByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await axe(container.ownerDocument.body, AXE_OPTIONS)).toHaveNoViolations();
  });

  it('moves focus into the dialog and wraps Tab and Shift+Tab inside it', async () => {
    render(<ProSheet {...buildProps()} />);
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    await waitFor(() => expect(dialog.contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true));
    const focusable = listFocusable(dialog);
    expect(focusable.length).toBeGreaterThan(2);
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

    act(() => last.focus());
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.keyDown(last, { key: 'Tab', code: 'Tab' });
    });
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(first);

    act(() => first.focus());
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.keyDown(first, { key: 'Tab', code: 'Tab', shiftKey: true });
    });
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(last);
  });

  it('keeps focus inside the dialog when a purchase starts and the buttons turn busy', async () => {
    const props = buildProps();
    const { rerender } = render(<ProSheet {...props} />);
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    const annual = within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'A year for £17.49' });
    act(() => annual.focus());
    const focusTargets: Element[] = [];
    function recordFocus(event: FocusEvent) {
      focusTargets.push(event.target as Element);
    }
    document.addEventListener('focusin', recordFocus);
    try {
      rerender(<ProSheet {...props} isBuying />);
      const busy = within(screen.getByRole('dialog')).getByRole('button', { name: 'A year for £17.49' });
      expect(busy.getAttribute('aria-disabled')).toBe('true');
      expect(screen.getByRole('dialog').contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
      expect(focusTargets.filter((target) => !screen.getByRole('dialog').contains(target))).toEqual([]);
    } finally {
      document.removeEventListener('focusin', recordFocus);
    }
  });

  it('closes on Escape without buying', async () => {
    const props = buildProps();
    render(<ProSheet {...props} />);
    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    await waitFor(() => expect(dialog.contains(document.activeElement)).toBe(true));
    await act(async () => {
      fireEvent.keyDown(document.activeElement ?? dialog, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape' });
    });
    expect(props.onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(props.onBuy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('counts as an open modal while mounted, so quiz keys are inert', () => {
    expect(isModalOpen()).toBe(false);
    const { unmount } = render(<ProSheet {...buildProps()} />);
    expect(isModalOpen()).toBe(true);
    unmount();
    expect(isModalOpen()).toBe(false);
  });

  it('slides in when motion is allowed and does not under reduced motion', () => {
    const { unmount } = render(<ProSheet {...buildProps()} />);
    expect(isSliding(readPanelStyle())).toBe(true);
    unmount();
    mockMotion.isReduced = true;
    render(<ProSheet {...buildProps()} />);
    expect(isSliding(readPanelStyle())).toBe(false);
  });

  it('says Pro is in the mobile apps, with no buy button, when there are no prices and no Web Billing key', () => {
    setExpoExtra({ apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.syntactical.dev/v1/' });
    render(<ProSheet {...buildProps({ prices: {} })} />);
    expect(screen.getByText(WEB_UNAVAILABLE)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^(A year|Forever)/ })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Not now' })).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('offers "A year" and "Forever" when a Web Billing key is set but prices have not loaded', () => {
    render(<ProSheet {...buildProps({ prices: {} })} />);
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'A year' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Forever' })).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText(WEB_UNAVAILABLE)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

`components/purchase/ProSheet.tsx`:

```tsx
// The Syntactical Pro sheet: a modal dialog with one h1, the two benefits, a button per Pro
// product with the store's localized price (never a hard-coded one), a line on how each renews,
// and "Not now". It records paywall_viewed once per opening with where it was opened from. On the
// web with no prices and no Web Billing key it says Pro is in the mobile apps instead of offering
// buttons that cannot work. On the web the slide-in is switched off under reduced motion, focus
// moves into the sheet, Tab and Shift+Tab wrap inside it, Escape closes it, and focus returns to
// what had it. On native it is a Modal. Quiz key bindings are inert while it is open.
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

import { Platform, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { trackEvent } from '../../clients/analyticsClient';
import { readExtraString } from '../../config/readExtraString';
import { PRO_PRODUCT_IDS } from '../../constants/proProducts';
import { useIsReducedMotion } from '../../state/useIsReducedMotion';
import { AuthButton } from '../auth/AuthButton';
import { DialogShell } from '../layout/DialogShell';
import { useModalPanel } from '../layout/useModalPanel';

const HEADING_ID = 'pro-sheet-heading';
const RENEWAL_NOTE = 'A year renews until you cancel; forever is one payment.';
const WEB_UNAVAILABLE = 'Pro is available in the iOS and Android apps for now.';

export type ProSheetSource = 'ask_limit' | 'house_card' | 'results' | 'settings';

type ProSheetProps = {
  isBuying: boolean;
  message: string | null;
  onBuy: (productId: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  prices: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  source: ProSheetSource;
};

function buildLabel(plan: string, price: string | undefined): string {
  return price === undefined ? plan : `${plan} for ${price}`;
}

export function ProSheet({ isBuying, message, onBuy, onClose, prices, source }: ProSheetProps) {
  const panelRef = useRef<View>(null);
  const isReducedMotion = useIsReducedMotion();
  const isWeb = Platform.OS === 'web';
  const hasPrices = Object.keys(prices).length > 0;
  const isWebUnavailable = isWeb && !hasPrices && readExtraString('revenueCatWebBillingKey') === null;
  // Read once: a later source change on the same opening records nothing new.
  const sourceRef = useRef(source);

  useEffect(() => {
    trackEvent('paywall_viewed', { source: sourceRef.current });
  }, []);
  useModalPanel(panelRef, { onClose });

  const slide = { animation: isReducedMotion ? 'none' : 'paywall-slide-up 200ms ease-out' };
  const panel = (
    <View
      className="absolute inset-0 items-center justify-end bg-obsidian/90 sm:justify-center"
      style={isWeb ? { position: 'fixed' as 'absolute' } : undefined}
    >
      <View
        ref={panelRef}
        role="dialog"
        // Native role queries (and the dialog's own announcement) need the dialog itself to be accessible.
        accessible
        aria-modal={true}
        accessibilityViewIsModal
        aria-labelledby={HEADING_ID}
        testID="pro-sheet-panel"
        tabIndex={-1}
        style={isWeb ? (slide as object) : undefined}
        className="w-full max-w-md border border-line bg-surface p-4"
      >
        <Text role="heading" aria-level={1} nativeID={HEADING_ID} className="font-mono text-lg text-ink">
          Syntactical Pro
        </Text>
        <View className="mt-3 gap-1">
          <Text className="text-sm text-ink">No sponsored cards</Text>
          <Text className="text-sm text-ink">20 asks a day</Text>
        </View>
        {message === null ? null : (
          <Text role="alert" className="mt-2 text-sm text-ink">
            {message}
          </Text>
        )}
        {isWebUnavailable ? (
          <Text className="mt-6 text-sm text-ink">{WEB_UNAVAILABLE}</Text>
        ) : (
          <>
            <AuthButton
              label={buildLabel('A year', prices[PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.ANNUAL])}
              isDisabled={isBuying}
              onPress={() => onBuy(PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.ANNUAL)}
            />
            <AuthButton
              label={buildLabel('Forever', prices[PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.LIFETIME])}
              isDisabled={isBuying}
              isPrimary={false}
              onPress={() => onBuy(PRO_PRODUCT_IDS.LIFETIME)}
            />
            <Text className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted">{RENEWAL_NOTE}</Text>
          </>
        )}
        <AuthButton label="Not now" isDisabled={isBuying} isPrimary={false} onPress={onClose} />
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <DialogShell animationType={isReducedMotion ? 'none' : 'slide'} onRequestClose={onClose}>
      {panel}
    </DialogShell>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

`clients/normalizeProductId.ts`:

```ts
// A store product identifier as the app spells product ids. RevenueCat reports a Google Play
// subscription as <subscription id>:<base plan id> (syntactical.pro.annual:yearly); this returns
// the part before the colon. Any other string, a malformed a: or a:b:c included, comes back
// unchanged. The server normalizes webhook product ids with the same rule.
const BASE_PLAN_SUFFIXED_ID = /^[a-z0-9.]+:[a-z0-9-]+$/;

export function normalizeProductId(productId: string): string {
  if (!BASE_PLAN_SUFFIXED_ID.test(productId)) return productId;
  return productId.slice(0, productId.indexOf(':'));
}
```

```tsx
// usePurchases confirm cancellation: a caller that aborts while GET me is pending gets false and
// no event, though the refetched Pro status still lands in the useProStatus cache; one that does
// not abort gets true and one purchase_completed plus one pro_purchased.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { PropsWithChildren } from 'react';

import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { act, renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';

import { trackEvent } from '../../clients/analyticsClient';
import { fakeAuth } from '../../components/purchase/__tests__/purchaseFlowFakes';
import { setExpoExtra } from '../../config/expoConstantsMock';
import { createQueryClient } from '../../config/queryClient';
import { usePurchases } from '../usePurchases';
import { buildProStatusKey } from '../useProStatus';

import { holdReply, installRoutedFetch, type FakeReply } from './authTestSupport';

setExpoExtra({ apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.syntactical.dev/v1/' });

jest.mock('expo-secure-store', () => ({
  getItemAsync: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(null)),
  setItemAsync: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  deleteItemAsync: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

jest.mock('../../state/AuthProvider', () =>
  require('../../components/purchase/__tests__/purchaseFlowFakes').buildAuthModule(),
);

jest.mock('../../clients/analyticsClient', () => ({ trackEvent: jest.fn() }));

jest.mock('../../clients/purchaseStoreClient', () => ({
  buyStoreProduct: jest.fn(),
  readStorePrices: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({})),
  restoreStorePurchases: jest.fn(),
}));

const PRODUCT = 'syntactical.pro.annual';
const EXPIRY = '2027-10-27T12:00:00.000Z';
let queryClient: ReturnType<typeof createQueryClient>;

function QueryWrapper({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
  return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
}

function activeReply(): FakeReply {
  return {
    status: 200,
    body: {
      data: {
        dailyGoal: 10,
        dayStreak: 0,
        email: 'reader@example.test',
        pro: { expiresAt: EXPIRY, isActive: true, product: 'annual' },
        timezone: null,
        xpToday: 0,
        xpTotal: 0,
      },
    },
  };
}

describe('usePurchases confirm cancellation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    fakeAuth.userId = randomUUID();
    queryClient = createQueryClient();
    jest.mocked(trackEvent).mockReset();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    queryClient.clear();
  });

  it('returns false without any event when aborted while GET me is pending', async () => {
    const held = holdReply();
    const { requests } = installRoutedFetch({ 'GET me': held });
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const { result } = await renderHook(() => usePurchases(), { wrapper: QueryWrapper });

    const confirmation = result.current.confirm(PRODUCT, { signal: controller.signal });
    await waitFor(() => expect(requests).toHaveLength(1));
    controller.abort();
    await act(async () => {
      held.release(activeReply());
      await confirmation;
    });

    expect(queryClient.getQueryData(buildProStatusKey(fakeAuth.userId))).toEqual({
      expiresAt: EXPIRY,
      isPro: true,
      product: 'annual',
    });
    await expect(confirmation).resolves.toBe(false);
    expect(trackEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns true and records one purchase_completed and one pro_purchased when not aborted', async () => {
    const held = holdReply();
    const { requests } = installRoutedFetch({ 'GET me': held });
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const { result } = await renderHook(() => usePurchases(), { wrapper: QueryWrapper });

    const confirmation = result.current.confirm(PRODUCT, { signal: controller.signal });
    await waitFor(() => expect(requests).toHaveLength(1));
    await act(async () => {
      held.release(activeReply());
      await confirmation;
    });

    await expect(confirmation).resolves.toBe(true);
    expect(jest.mocked(trackEvent).mock.calls).toEqual([
      ['purchase_completed', { productId: PRODUCT }],
      ['pro_purchased', { product: 'annual' }],
    ]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
// purchase-complete and the Pro status cache: a route that remounts while the first GET me is
// pending sends no second request and records one purchase_completed once it answers; and the
// confirmed status is left in the useProStatus cache for the signed-in user, with
// purchase_completed and pro_purchased recorded exactly once.
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { Slot } from 'expo-router';
import { act, renderRouter, screen } from 'expo-router/testing-library';

import { fakeAuth } from '../../components/purchase/__tests__/purchaseFlowFakes';
import { setExpoExtra } from '../../config/expoConstantsMock';
import { createQueryClient } from '../../config/queryClient';
import { holdReply, installRoutedFetch, type RouteReply } from '../../state/__tests__/authTestSupport';
import { buildProStatusKey } from '../../state/useProStatus';
import PurchaseCompleteScreen from '../purchase-complete';

setExpoExtra({ apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.syntactical.dev/v1/' });

jest.mock('expo-secure-store', () => ({
  getItemAsync: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(null)),
  setItemAsync: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
  deleteItemAsync: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

jest.mock('../../state/AuthProvider', () =>
  require('../../components/purchase/__tests__/purchaseFlowFakes').buildAuthModule(),
);

const mockTrackEvent = jest.fn();
jest.mock('../../clients/analyticsClient', () => ({
  trackEvent: (...args: unknown[]) => mockTrackEvent(...args),
}));

const PRODUCT = 'syntactical.pro.lifetime';
const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 2000;
const DEADLINE_MS = 30_000;
const UNLOCKED = 'Unlocked';
let queryClient: ReturnType<typeof createQueryClient>;
let userId: string;

function MenuStub() {
  return null;
}

function QueryLayout() {
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <Slot />
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

const ROUTES = { _layout: QueryLayout, index: MenuStub, 'purchase-complete': PurchaseCompleteScreen };

function profileReply(isPro: boolean): RouteReply {
  const pro = isPro
    ? { expiresAt: null, isActive: true, product: 'lifetime' }
    : { expiresAt: null, isActive: false, product: null };
  return {
    status: 200,
    body: { data: { dailyGoal: 10, dayStreak: 0, email: 'reader@example.test', pro, timezone: null, xpToday: 0 } },
  };
}

async function flush(): Promise<void> {
  for (let round = 0; round < 5; round += 1) {
    await act(async () => {
      await Promise.resolve();
    });
  }
}

async function advance(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  for (let elapsed = 0; elapsed < ms; elapsed += 500) {
    await act(async () => {
      jest.advanceTimersByTime(Math.min(500, ms - elapsed));
    });
    await flush();
  }
}

async function open(product: string): Promise<{ unmount(): Promise<void> }> {
  const rendered = await renderRouter(ROUTES, {
    initialUrl: `/purchase-complete?product=${encodeURIComponent(product)}`,
  });
  await flush();
  return { unmount: () => rendered.unmount() };
}

function listEvents(name: string): unknown[][] {
  return mockTrackEvent.mock.calls.filter(([event]) => event === name);
}

describe('purchase-complete Pro status cache', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    userId = randomUUID();
    fakeAuth.userId = userId;
    queryClient = createQueryClient();
    mockTrackEvent.mockReset();
    jest.useFakeTimers();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    queryClient.clear();
    jest.useRealTimers();
  });

  it('records one purchase_completed when the route remounts while the first GET me is pending', async () => {
    const held = holdReply();
    const { requests } = installRoutedFetch({ 'GET me': [held, profileReply(true)] });
    const first = await open(PRODUCT);
    expect(screen.getByText('Confirming your purchase')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(requests.filter(({ method, path }) => method === 'GET' && path === 'me')).toHaveLength(1);

    await first.unmount();
    await open(PRODUCT);
    expect(screen.getByText('Confirming your purchase')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(requests.filter(({ method, path }) => method === 'GET' && path === 'me')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(listEvents('purchase_completed')).toHaveLength(0);

    held.release(profileReply(true) as Parameters<typeof held.release>[0]);
    await flush();

    expect(screen.getByText(UNLOCKED)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(listEvents('purchase_completed')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('leaves the confirmed Pro status in the cache and records each purchase event once', async () => {
    installRoutedFetch({ 'GET me': [profileReply(false), profileReply(true)] });
    await open(PRODUCT);
    expect(screen.getByText('Confirming your purchase')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(queryClient.getQueryData(buildProStatusKey(userId))).toMatchObject({ isPro: false });

    await advance(POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect(screen.getByText(UNLOCKED)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(queryClient.getQueryData(buildProStatusKey(userId))).toEqual({
      expiresAt: null,
      isPro: true,
      product: 'lifetime',
    });
    expect(listEvents('purchase_completed')).toEqual([['purchase_completed', { productId: PRODUCT }]]);
    expect(listEvents('pro_purchased')).toEqual([['pro_purchased', { product: 'lifetime' }]]);

    await advance(DEADLINE_MS + POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
    expect(listEvents('purchase_completed')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(listEvents('pro_purchased')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

```ts
// Shared fakes for the Pro purchase suites. The purchase SDKs are faked at their wrapper
// boundaries: react-native-purchases on native, clients/webBillingClient on the web. The server is
// a routed fetch stub whose GET me answers with fakeServer.pro, so Pro shows only when the server
// says so. The native SDK's own customer info always claims both products are active: a client
// that trusts the SDK's result instead of /me shows it.
import {
  CONTENT_BASE_URL,
  MANIFEST_URL,
  cloneBundledManifest,
  stubFetchRoutes,
  type FetchRoute,
} from '../../../services/content/__tests__/fixtures/contentFixtures';
import { buildExpoRouterMock } from '../../../config/buildExpoRouterMock';

export { CONTENT_BASE_URL, MANIFEST_URL };

export const API_BASE = 'https://api.syntactical.dev/v1/';
export const ME_URL = `${API_BASE}me`;
export const ANNUAL_PRODUCT = 'syntactical.pro.annual';
export const LIFETIME_PRODUCT = 'syntactical.pro.lifetime';
export const SIGNED_IN_USER = 'a6f1d1c2-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a';
// Noon UTC, so the date is the same in every time zone a CI runner uses.
export const ANNUAL_EXPIRES_AT = '2027-10-27T12:00:00.000Z';

// Localized store prices, deliberately not the US list prices ($19.99, $39.99), so a hard-coded
// price cannot pass.
export const NATIVE_PRICES: Record<string, string> = {
  [ANNUAL_PRODUCT]: '€21,99',
  [LIFETIME_PRODUCT]: '€43,99',
};
export const WEB_PRICES: Record<string, string> = {
  [ANNUAL_PRODUCT]: '£17.49',
  [LIFETIME_PRODUCT]: '£34.99',
};

export type FakePro = { expiresAt: string | null; isActive: boolean; product: 'annual' | 'lifetime' | null };

export const FREE_PRO: FakePro = { expiresAt: null, isActive: false, product: null };

// What GET me says once the webhook for this product reached the server.
export function buildActivePro(productId: string): FakePro {
  return productId === LIFETIME_PRODUCT
    ? { expiresAt: null, isActive: true, product: 'lifetime' }
    : { expiresAt: ANNUAL_EXPIRES_AT, isActive: true, product: 'annual' };
}

// The server's view: the Pro status GET me returns, and an ordered log of SDK calls and GET me
// requests. While meGate is set, every GET me answer waits for it (see holdMe).
export const fakeServer: { events: string[]; meGate: Promise<void> | null; pro: FakePro } = {
  events: [],
  meGate: null,
  pro: FREE_PRO,
};

// Holds every GET me answer until the returned release function is called.
export function holdMe(): () => void {
  let release: () => void = () => undefined;
  fakeServer.meGate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    release = () => {
      fakeServer.meGate = null;
      resolve();
    };
  });
  return release;
}

// The signed-in user, or null for a guest.
export const fakeAuth: { userId: string | null } = { userId: null };

// Every navigation the screen asked expo-router for.
export const fakeNavigation: { calls: unknown[] } = { calls: [] };

export type NativePurchaseBehavior = 'webhook-grants' | 'no-grant' | 'cancel' | 'fail';
// no-grant: the store restores, but the server's GET me still says free.
export type NativeRestoreBehavior = 'webhook-grants' | 'no-grant' | 'fail';

export const nativeSdk: {
  offeringsError: Error | null;
  purchaseBehavior: NativePurchaseBehavior;
  purchasedProductIds: string[];
  restoreBehavior: NativeRestoreBehavior;
  restoreCount: number;
} = {
  offeringsError: null,
  purchaseBehavior: 'webhook-grants',
  purchasedProductIds: [],
  restoreBehavior: 'webhook-grants',
  restoreCount: 0,
};

export type WebPurchaseBehavior = 'purchased' | 'cancelled' | 'unavailable';

// While purchaseGate is set, purchaseWebBillingProduct stays in flight until it resolves.
export const webBilling: {
  purchaseBehavior: WebPurchaseBehavior;
  purchaseGate: Promise<void> | null;
  purchasedProductIds: string[];
} = {
  purchaseBehavior: 'purchased',
  purchaseGate: null,
  purchasedProductIds: [],
};

export function resetFakes(): void {
  fakeServer.events = [];
  fakeServer.meGate = null;
  fakeServer.pro = FREE_PRO;
  fakeAuth.userId = null;
  fakeNavigation.calls = [];
  nativeSdk.offeringsError = null;
  nativeSdk.purchaseBehavior = 'webhook-grants';
  nativeSdk.purchasedProductIds = [];
  nativeSdk.restoreBehavior = 'webhook-grants';
  nativeSdk.restoreCount = 0;
  webBilling.purchaseBehavior = 'purchased';
  webBilling.purchaseGate = null;
  webBilling.purchasedProductIds = [];
}

// The state/AuthProvider stand-in: a hydrated guest or signed-in user.
export function buildAuthModule() {
  function useAuth() {
    const userId = fakeAuth.userId;
    return {
      completeGuestClaim: () => undefined,
      guestClaimUserId: null,
      isHydrated: true,
      isSignedIn: userId !== null,
      requestCode: () => Promise.resolve({ isOk: false, reason: 'unavailable' }),
      signOut: () => Promise.resolve(),
      user: userId === null ? null : { id: userId },
      verifyCode: () => Promise.resolve({ isOk: false, reason: 'unavailable' }),
    };
  }
  return {
    AuthProvider: ({ children }: { children: unknown }) => children,
    useAuth,
    useSignedInUserId: () => fakeAuth.userId,
  };
}

// The expo-router stand-in: navigation is recorded, never performed.
export function buildRouterModule(readParams: () => Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>) {
  return buildExpoRouterMock({
    readParams,
    record: (href: unknown) => {
      fakeNavigation.calls.push(href);
    },
  });
}

// An href passed to expo-router (a string or { pathname, params }) as a URL.
export function toUrl(href: unknown): URL {
  if (typeof href === 'string') return new URL(href, 'https://app.test');
  const { params = {}, pathname } = href as {
    params?: Record<string, unknown>;
    pathname: string;
  };
  const url = new URL(pathname, 'https://app.test');
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(params)) url.searchParams.set(key, String(value));
  return url;
}

export function listNavigatedUrls(): URL[] {
  return fakeNavigation.calls.map(toUrl);
}

function buildCustomerInfo() {
  // The SDK claims both products are active; the client must not believe it.
  const active = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.keys(NATIVE_PRICES).map((productId) => [
      productId,
      { identifier: productId, isActive: true, productIdentifier: productId },
    ]),
  );
  return {
    activeSubscriptions: [ANNUAL_PRODUCT],
    allPurchasedProductIdentifiers: Object.keys(NATIVE_PRICES),
    entitlements: { active, all: active },
    nonSubscriptionTransactions: [{ productIdentifier: LIFETIME_PRODUCT }],
    originalAppUserId: SIGNED_IN_USER,
  };
}

function buildStoreError(code: string, isCancelled: boolean): Error {
  return Object.assign(new Error(isCancelled ? 'Purchase was cancelled.' : 'Store problem.'), {
    code,
    userCancelled: isCancelled,
  });
}

type NativePackage = {
  identifier: string;
  offeringIdentifier: string;
  packageType: string;
  product: {
    currencyCode: string;
    identifier: string;
    price: number;
    priceString: string;
    title: string;
  };
};

// The RevenueCat offering: $rc_annual and $rc_lifetime, as docs/store/in-app-purchases.md sets it up.
function buildNativePackages(): NativePackage[] {
  return [
    { identifier: '$rc_annual', packageType: 'ANNUAL', productId: ANNUAL_PRODUCT },
    { identifier: '$rc_lifetime', packageType: 'LIFETIME', productId: LIFETIME_PRODUCT },
  ].map(({ identifier, packageType, productId }) => {
    const priceString = NATIVE_PRICES[productId];
    return {
      identifier,
      offeringIdentifier: 'default',
      packageType,
      product: {
        currencyCode: 'EUR',
        identifier: productId,
        price: Number(priceString.replace(/[^0-9,]/g, '').replace(',', '.')),
        priceString,
        title: productId,
      },
    };
  });
}

// The react-native-purchases stand-in. purchasePackage and restorePurchases model the store:
// 'webhook-grants' means RevenueCat's webhook reached the server, so the next GET me says Pro.
// A restore that grants restores a lifetime purchase made on another install.
export function buildNativePurchasesModule() {
  const offering = {
    availablePackages: buildNativePackages(),
    identifier: 'default',
    metadata: {},
    serverDescription: '',
  };
  const Purchases = {
    configure: jest.fn(),
    getCustomerInfo: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(buildCustomerInfo())),
    getOfferings: jest.fn(() =>
      nativeSdk.offeringsError
        ? Promise.reject(nativeSdk.offeringsError)
        : Promise.resolve({ all: { default: offering }, current: offering }),
    ),
    isConfigured: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(true)),
    logIn: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ created: false, customerInfo: buildCustomerInfo() })),
    logOut: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(buildCustomerInfo())),
    purchasePackage: jest.fn((rcPackage: NativePackage) => {
      const productId = rcPackage?.product?.identifier;
      fakeServer.events.push(`purchasePackage ${productId}`);
      nativeSdk.purchasedProductIds.push(productId);
      const behavior = nativeSdk.purchaseBehavior;
      if (behavior === 'cancel') return Promise.reject(buildStoreError('1', true));
      if (behavior === 'fail') return Promise.reject(buildStoreError('2', false));
      if (behavior === 'webhook-grants') fakeServer.pro = buildActivePro(productId);
      return Promise.resolve({ customerInfo: buildCustomerInfo(), productIdentifier: productId });
    }),
    restorePurchases: jest.fn(() => {
      fakeServer.events.push('restorePurchases');
      nativeSdk.restoreCount += 1;
      if (nativeSdk.restoreBehavior === 'fail') return Promise.reject(buildStoreError('2', false));
      if (nativeSdk.restoreBehavior === 'webhook-grants') fakeServer.pro = buildActivePro(LIFETIME_PRODUCT);
      return Promise.resolve(buildCustomerInfo());
    }),
  };
  return {
    __esModule: true,
    default: Purchases,
    PURCHASES_ERROR_CODE: {
      PURCHASE_CANCELLED_ERROR: '1',
      STORE_PROBLEM_ERROR: '2',
      UNKNOWN_ERROR: '0',
    },
  };
}

// The clients/webBillingClient stand-in: product id to the offering's localized price, and a
// purchase that never grants by itself (purchase-complete confirms checkout's return through /me).
export function buildWebBillingModule() {
  return {
    configureWebBilling: jest.fn(),
    purchaseWebBillingProduct: jest.fn((productId: string) => {
      fakeServer.events.push(`purchaseWebBillingProduct ${productId}`);
      webBilling.purchasedProductIds.push(productId);
      const gate = webBilling.purchaseGate ?? Promise.resolve();
      return gate.then(() => webBilling.purchaseBehavior);
    }),
    readWebBillingPrices: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ ...WEB_PRICES })),
    resetWebBilling: jest.fn(),
  };
}

function meRoute(): FetchRoute {
  return async () => {
    fakeServer.events.push('GET me');
    await fakeServer.meGate;
    return JSON.stringify({
      data: { dailyGoal: 20, dayStreak: 0, pro: fakeServer.pro, timezone: null, xpToday: 0, xpTotal: 0 },
    });
  };
}

// Serves the bundled manifest and GET me; every other request fails like an offline request.
export function serveApp(): jest.Mock {
  return stubFetchRoutes(
    {
      [MANIFEST_URL]: () => Promise.resolve(JSON.stringify(cloneBundledManifest())),
      [ME_URL]: meRoute(),
    },
    { shouldRejectUnrouted: true },
  );
}

export function countMeRequests(): number {
  return fakeServer.events.filter((event) => event === 'GET me').length;
}
```

```tsx
// Restore purchases in Settings on native: the control calls react-native-purchases'

import { QueryClientProvider, type QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import '../../components/auth/__tests__/preloadNativeModal';

jest.mock('expo-router', () =>
  require('../../components/purchase/__tests__/purchaseFlowFakes').buildRouterModule(() => ({})),
);
jest.mock('../../state/useIsOnline', () => ({ useIsOnline: () => true }));
jest.mock('../../state/StatsProvider', () => ({

}));
jest.mock('../../state/useProfile', () => ({
  useProfile: () => ({ snapshot: null, updateDailyGoal: () => Promise.resolve(true) }),
}));
jest.mock('../../state/useProgressSummary', () => ({

}));
jest.mock('../../components/auth/SignOutDialog', () => ({ SignOutDialog: () => null }));

jest.mock('../../clients/analyticsClient', () => ({ trackEvent: () => undefined }));

const latest: { status: string } = { status: '' };

// Shows what useProStatus reads, so a test can see it follow the server.
function ProStatusProbe() {
  const state = useProStatus();
  latest.status = state.status === 'ready' ? (state.isPro ? `pro ${state.product}` : 'free') : state.status;
  return null;
}

let queryClient: QueryClient;

async function renderSettings(): Promise<void> {
  await render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <SettingsScreen />
      <ProStatusProbe />
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
  await settle();
}

async function pressRestore(): Promise<void> {
  await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Restore purchases' }));
  await settle();
}

beforeEach(() => {
  resetFakes();
  queryClient = createQueryClient();
  fakeAuth.userId = SIGNED_IN_USER;
  latest.status = '';
  serveApp();
  jest.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await settle();
  queryClient.clear();
  jest.restoreAllMocks();
});

describe('Restore purchases in Settings on native', () => {
  it('calls restorePurchases, then GET me, and Pro follows what the server now says', async () => {
    await renderSettings();
    await waitFor(() => expect(latest.status).toBe('free'));
    const meBefore = countMeRequests();

    await pressRestore();

    expect(nativeSdk.restoreCount).toBe(1);
    await waitFor(() => expect(latest.status).toBe('pro lifetime'));
    expect(countMeRequests()).toBeGreaterThan(meBefore);
    const restoreAt = fakeServer.events.indexOf('restorePurchases');
    expect(fakeServer.events.slice(restoreAt + 1)).toContain('GET me');
  });

  it('a failed restore leaves the user free', async () => {
    nativeSdk.restoreBehavior = 'fail';
    await renderSettings();
    await waitFor(() => expect(latest.status).toBe('free'));

    await pressRestore();

    expect(nativeSdk.restoreCount).toBe(1);
    expect(latest.status).toBe('free');
  });

  it('a restore the store accepts but GET me does not confirm leaves the user free', async () => {
    nativeSdk.restoreBehavior = 'no-grant';
    await renderSettings();
    await waitFor(() => expect(latest.status).toBe('free'));

    await pressRestore();

    const restoreAt = fakeServer.events.indexOf('restorePurchases');
    expect(restoreAt).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    await waitFor(() => expect(fakeServer.events.slice(restoreAt + 1)).toContain('GET me'));
    await settle();
    expect(latest.status).toBe('free');
  });
});
```

```ts
      queryKey: buildEntitlementsKey(userId),
      staleTime: 0,
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}, [queryClient, userId]);

// Refetches GET /me; true (and records purchase_completed) when it lists the
// product and the caller has not aborted meanwhile.
const confirm = useCallback(
  async (productId: string, { signal }: ConfirmOptions = {}): Promise<boolean> => {
    const entitlements = await refetchEntitlements();
    if (signal?.aborted || !entitlements?.includes(productId)) return false;
    trackEvent('purchase_completed', { productId });
    return true;
  },
  [refetchEntitlements],
);
```

```ts
// The server's Pro status after a fresh GET /me, or null when it fails.
const refetchProStatus = useCallback(async (): Promise<ProStatus | null> => {
  try {
    return await queryClient.fetchQuery({
      queryFn: fetchProStatus,
      queryKey: buildProStatusKey(userId),
      staleTime: 0,
    });
  } catch {
    return null;

// Refetches GET /me; true when it says Pro is active and the caller has not aborted meanwhile.
// Then records purchase_completed with the product id and, for a Pro product (a Play base-plan
// suffix stripped), pro_purchased with its plan.
const confirm = useCallback(
  async (productId: string, { signal }: ConfirmOptions = {}): Promise<boolean> => {
    const pro = await refetchProStatus();
    if (signal?.aborted || pro?.isPro !== true) return false;
    trackEvent('purchase_completed', { productId });
    const plan = readProPlan(normalizeProductId(productId));
    if (plan !== null) trackEvent('pro_purchased', { product: plan });
    return true;
  },
  [refetchProStatus],
);
```

```tsx
  it('after a pending purchase, re-checks GET me on its own and closes once the server says Pro', async () => {
    jest.useFakeTimers();
    isFakeClock = true;
    nativeSdk.purchaseBehavior = 'no-grant';
    await renderOffer();
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: ANNUAL_BUTTON });
    await pressInDialog(ANNUAL_BUTTON);
    await settle();
    expect(await screen.findByText(PURCHASE_PENDING, HIDDEN)).toBeTruthy();

    // The RevenueCat webhook reaches the server after the purchase returned.
    fakeServer.pro = buildActivePro(ANNUAL_PRODUCT);
    const meAfterPurchase = countMeRequests();
    for (let elapsed = 0; elapsed < 5000; elapsed += 250) {
      await act(async () => {
        await jest.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(250);
      });
    }

    expect(countMeRequests()).toBeGreaterThan(meAfterPurchase);
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('closes when the user signs out while it is open, leaving no buy button', async () => {
    const rendered = await renderOffer();
    await screen.findByRole('button', { name: ANNUAL_BUTTON });
    fakeAuth.userId = null;
    await rendered.rerender(buildTree());
    await settle();
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^A year/, ...HIDDEN })).toBeNull();
    expect(nativeSdk.purchasedProductIds).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('renders nothing for a guest and never calls the SDK', async () => {
    fakeAuth.userId = null;
    await renderOffer();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', HIDDEN)).toBeNull();
    expect(readSdk().getOfferings.mock.calls).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(readSdk().purchasePackage.mock.calls).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(mockTrackEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

`components/purchase/ProOffer.tsx`:

```tsx
// The Pro sheet wired to the stores: it loads the store's prices and runs a purchase from the
// sheet. A native purchase closes the sheet once GET /me says Pro; one the store finished while
// /me does not say Pro yet says it is still processing and is re-checked twice, two seconds
// apart, while mounted; a failed purchase says so and a cancelled one says nothing. A web purchase
// goes to /purchase-complete for that product, where checkout's return is confirmed. The sheet
// cannot be closed while a purchase runs. A guest sees nothing, and signing out closes it.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { router } from 'expo-router';

import { useSignedInUserId } from '../../state/AuthProvider';
import { usePurchases } from '../../state/usePurchases';

import { ProSheet, type ProSheetSource } from './ProSheet';

const PURCHASE_FAILED = 'The purchase did not go through. Try again.';
const PURCHASE_PENDING = 'Your purchase is still processing. Check back shortly.';
const PENDING_RECHECK_COUNT = 2;
const PENDING_RECHECK_DELAY_MS = 2000;

type ProOfferProps = { onClose: () => void; source: ProSheetSource };

export function ProOffer({ onClose, source }: ProOfferProps) {
  const userId = useSignedInUserId();
  const { buy, confirm, prices } = usePurchases({ shouldLoadPrices: true });
  const [isBuying, setIsBuying] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const isMountedRef = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    isMountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      isMountedRef.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // With nobody signed in there is no account to buy for.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId === null) onClose();
  }, [onClose, userId]);

  const close = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isBuying) onClose();
  }, [isBuying, onClose]);

  async function recheckPending(productId: string) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < PENDING_RECHECK_COUNT; attempt += 1) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, PENDING_RECHECK_DELAY_MS));
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (await confirm(productId)) {
        if (isMountedRef.current) onClose();
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  async function buyProduct(productId: string) {
    setIsBuying(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const outcome = await buy(productId);
      if (!isMountedRef.current) return;
      if (outcome === 'redirect') router.push({ params: { product: productId }, pathname: '/purchase-complete' });
      if (outcome === 'unavailable') setMessage(PURCHASE_FAILED);
      if (outcome === 'pending') {
        setMessage(PURCHASE_PENDING);
        void recheckPending(productId);
      }
      if (outcome === 'redirect' || outcome === 'unlocked') onClose();
    } finally {
      if (isMountedRef.current) setIsBuying(false);
    }
  }

  if (userId === null) return null;
  return (
    <ProSheet
      isBuying={isBuying}
      message={message}
      onBuy={(productId) => void buyProduct(productId)}
      onClose={close}
      prices={prices}
      source={source}
    />
  );
}
```

`clients/webBillingClient/readWebBillingManagementUrl.ts`:

```ts
// Web Billing's page where the signed-in customer manages or cancels a subscription, from the
// configured instance's CustomerInfo.managementURL. Null when Web Billing is not configured, when
// RevenueCat reports none, or when the read fails, so a caller shows no link rather than a guess.
import { logWarning } from '../logClient';

import { webBillingState } from './webBillingState';

export async function readWebBillingManagementUrl(): Promise<string | null> {
  const current = webBillingState.current;
  if (current === null) return null;
  try {
    return (await current.instance.getCustomerInfo()).managementURL ?? null;
  } catch {
    logWarning({ err: new Error('web billing customer info unavailable') }, 'web management url unavailable');
    return null;
  }
}
```

```ts
// The store's page for managing this purchaser's subscription (App Store or Google Play), from
// RevenueCat's CustomerInfo.managementURL; null when RevenueCat reports none or the read fails.
export async function readManagementUrl(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    // The identity call configures the SDK; wait for it before reading customer info.
    await purchaserQueue.tail;
    return (await Purchases.getCustomerInfo()).managementURL ?? null;
  } catch {
    logWarning({ err: new Error('store customer info unavailable') }, 'store management url unavailable');
    return null;
  }
}
```

`state/useSubscriptionManagementUrl.ts`:

```ts
// The page where the signed-in user manages their subscription, as RevenueCat reports it
// (CustomerInfo.managementURL: the App Store, Google Play, or Web Billing). Read only while the
// caller enables it (a Pro row), keyed by user id under 'me' so an admin change refetches it; null
// while loading, when RevenueCat reports none, or when the read fails.
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { readManagementUrl } from '../clients/purchaseStoreClient';

import { useSignedInUserId } from './AuthProvider';

export function buildManagementUrlKey(userId: string | null) {
  return ['me', userId, 'management-url'] as const;
}

export function useSubscriptionManagementUrl(isEnabled: boolean): string | null {
  const userId = useSignedInUserId();
  const { data } = useQuery({
    enabled: isEnabled && userId !== null,
    queryFn: readManagementUrl,
    queryKey: buildManagementUrlKey(userId),
  });
  return data ?? null;
}
```

`components/purchase/ProRow.tsx`:

```tsx
// The Pro row in Settings for a signed-in user (a guest signs in first and sees nothing here).
// A free user gets "Go Pro", which opens the Pro sheet; an annual subscriber reads "Pro until
// <date>"; a lifetime owner (or an admin grant) reads "Pro, lifetime". A Pro user gets "Manage
// subscription" on every platform whenever RevenueCat reports a management page, so a subscription
// sold on the web can be cancelled on the web. Nothing shows while the status loads or after it fails.
import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';

import { useProStatus } from '../../state/useProStatus';
import { useSubscriptionManagementUrl } from '../../state/useSubscriptionManagementUrl';
import { ExternalLink } from '../query/ExternalLink';

import { ProOffer } from './ProOffer';

function formatExpiry(expiresAt: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, { dateStyle: 'long' }).format(new Date(expiresAt));
}

export function ProRow() {
  const proStatus = useProStatus();
  const isPro = proStatus.status === 'ready' && proStatus.isPro;
  const managementUrl = useSubscriptionManagementUrl(isPro);
  const [isOfferOpen, setIsOfferOpen] = useState(false);
  const closeOffer = useCallback(() => setIsOfferOpen(false), []);

  if (proStatus.status !== 'ready') return null;
  const { expiresAt, product } = proStatus;

  if (!isPro) {
    return (
      <View className="mt-4">
        <Pressable role="button" aria-label="Go Pro" onPress={() => setIsOfferOpen(true)}>
          <Text className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-ink">Go Pro</Text>
        </Pressable>
        {isOfferOpen ? <ProOffer source="settings" onClose={closeOffer} /> : null}
      </View>
    );
  }

  const isAnnual = product === 'annual' && expiresAt !== null;
  return (
    <View className="mt-4">
      <Text className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-ink">
        {isAnnual ? `Pro until ${formatExpiry(expiresAt)}` : 'Pro, lifetime'}
      </Text>
      {managementUrl === null ? null : (
        <ExternalLink className="mt-2" label="Manage subscription" url={managementUrl} />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}
```

### Task 4.9: Ask results carry the limit and the tier; no purchase refusal

**Files:**

- Modify: `services/ask/types/AskResult.ts` (whole file, 8 lines), `services/ask/requestAskAnswer.ts` (whole file, 46 lines), `components/query/AskPanel.tsx` (line 17 only; the copy changes in Task 4.10)
- Test: `services/ask/__tests__/requestAskAnswer.test.ts` (rewritten); `components/query/__tests__/AskPanel.test.tsx` (lines 34, 46-50, 73: the `locked` row goes and the answered fixtures gain `limit`); `components/quiz/__tests__/quizRoundAsk.test.tsx` (line 59: the answered fixture gains `limit`)

**Interfaces:**

- Consumes (area 3, Task 3.11, Ask by tier): a 200 from `POST /v1/ask` answers `{ data: { answer, limit, proLimit, remaining, tier } }`; the daily-limit 429 answers `{ error: { code: 'ASK_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED', limit, message, proLimit, requestId, tier } }`, so `limit`, `proLimit`, and `tier` sit inside the standard error envelope beside `code`. `tier` is `'free' | 'pro'`, the learner's tier when the server counted the ask; `limit` is that tier's daily limit; `proLimit` is the Pro tier's. Any other 429 (the per-minute `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`) carries none of them.
- Produces:
  - `export type AskTier = 'free' | 'pro'`
  - `export type AskFailure = 'busy' | 'limit' | 'unavailable'`
  - `export type AskResult = { answer: string; limit: number; remaining: number; status: 'answered' } | { limit?: number; proLimit?: number; reason: 'limit'; status: 'failed'; tier?: AskTier } | { reason: 'busy' | 'unavailable'; status: 'failed' }`
  - `requestAskAnswer(target, message): Promise<AskResult>`: a 200 needs a non-empty `answer`, a positive integer `limit`, and an integer `remaining` from 0 to `limit`, else `unavailable` (its `tier` and `proLimit` are not needed after an answer and are ignored); a 429 `ASK_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED` is `limit`, carrying each of `error.limit` and `error.proLimit` that is a positive integer and `error.tier` when it is `'free'` or `'pro'`. Area 3 always sends all three; a missing or malformed field is dropped on its own, so the panel falls back to plainer copy rather than failing. Any other 429 is `busy`; a 403 is now `unavailable` like any other refusal. The app holds no copy of the server's limits.

`services/ask/types/AskResult.ts`, replaced in full:

```ts
// What one ask came back with: the answer, the day's limit for the learner's tier, and the answers
// left of it; or why there is none. 'limit' is the daily limit, carrying the tier the server
// counted the ask against, that tier's limit, and the Pro tier's limit, each when the server names
// it; 'busy' the per-minute limit; 'unavailable' a failed, declined, or unconfigured model, an
// unexpected reply, or an unreachable server.
export type AskTier = 'free' | 'pro';

export type AskFailure = 'busy' | 'limit' | 'unavailable';

export type AskResult =
  | { answer: string; limit: number; remaining: number; status: 'answered' }
  | { limit?: number; proLimit?: number; reason: 'limit'; status: 'failed'; tier?: AskTier }
  | { reason: 'busy' | 'unavailable'; status: 'failed' };
```

`services/ask/requestAskAnswer.ts`, replaced in full:

```ts
// Sends one learner question about a quiz question to POST ask and reads the reply. Never throws:
// an unreachable server, a timeout, or an unexpected reply is 'unavailable'. A 200 carries the
// answer with the day's limit and the answers left of it; a 429 is the daily limit (with the tier,
// its limit, and the Pro limit the server names) or the per-minute burst limit. Asking needs only a
// session, so there is no purchase refusal to map. The limits are the server's: the app keeps no
// copy of them.
import { apiFetch } from '../../clients/apiClient';
import { readErrorCode } from '../../clients/readErrorCode';
import { ASK_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS, HTTP_STATUS_OK, HTTP_STATUS_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS } from '../../constants/appConfig';

import type { AskResult, AskTier } from './types/AskResult';
import type { AskTarget } from './types/AskTarget';

const DAILY_LIMIT_CODE = 'ASK_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED';

function isCount(value: unknown): value is number {
  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0;
}

function readAnswer(body: unknown): { answer: string; limit: number; remaining: number } | null {
  const data = (body as { data?: Record<string, unknown> } | null)?.data;
  const { answer, limit, remaining } = data ?? {};
  if (typeof answer !== 'string' || answer === '') return null;
  if (!isCount(limit) || limit === 0 || !isCount(remaining) || remaining > limit) return null;
  return { answer, limit, remaining };
}

function readPositiveCount(value: unknown): number | undefined {
  return isCount(value) && value > 0 ? value : undefined;
}

function readTier(value: unknown): AskTier | undefined {
  return value === 'free' || value === 'pro' ? value : undefined;
}

// What a daily-limit refusal names in its error envelope ({ error: { code, limit, message,
// proLimit, requestId, tier } }); each field is kept only when it is well formed.
function readDailyLimit(body: unknown): Extract<AskResult, { reason: 'limit' }> {
  const error = (body as { error?: Record<string, unknown> } | null)?.error ?? {};
  return {
    limit: readPositiveCount(error.limit),
    proLimit: readPositiveCount(error.proLimit),
    reason: 'limit',
    status: 'failed',
    tier: readTier(error.tier),
  };
}

export async function requestAskAnswer(target: AskTarget, message: string): Promise<AskResult> {
  let response: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof apiFetch>>;
  try {
    response = await apiFetch('ask', {
      body: { ...target, message },
      method: 'POST',
      timeoutMs: ASK_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS,
    });
  } catch {
    return { reason: 'unavailable', status: 'failed' };
  }
  const { body, status } = response;
  if (status === HTTP_STATUS_OK) {
    const reply = readAnswer(body);
    return reply ? { ...reply, status: 'answered' } : { reason: 'unavailable', status: 'failed' };
  }
  if (status === HTTP_STATUS_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS) {
    return readErrorCode(body) === DAILY_LIMIT_CODE ? readDailyLimit(body) : { reason: 'busy', status: 'failed' };
  }
  return { reason: 'unavailable', status: 'failed' };
}
```

```ts
// Whether the learner may ask about a question: the server answers anyone signed in, up to the
// day's limit for their tier, so the ask box shows for every signed-in user and never for a guest.
import { useSignedInUserId } from './AuthProvider';

export function useCanAsk(): boolean {
  return useSignedInUserId() !== null;
```

`components/query/AskPanel.tsx`, replaced in full:

```tsx
// "Ask about this card", at the end of the explanation: the learner types a follow-up question and
// gets a short answer from the server, which has the question, its answer key, and the choice they
// picked. Each ask stands alone; the panel shows the latest answer and "<remaining> of <limit> left
// today", and says why when there is none. At the daily limit it branches on the tier the server
// names, never on a number: a free learner is told the free tier's limit and the Pro limit and is
// offered Pro (See Pro opens the Pro sheet); a Pro learner is told the day's limit. The drawer keys
// the panel by question, so nothing carries over to the next card, and a reply that lands after
// the panel is gone is dropped.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, TextInput, View } from 'react-native';

import { ASK_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH } from '../../constants/appConfig';
import { requestAskAnswer } from '../../services/ask/requestAskAnswer';
import type { AskResult } from '../../services/ask/types/AskResult';
import type { AskTarget } from '../../services/ask/types/AskTarget';
import { ProOffer } from '../purchase/ProOffer';

const BUSY = 'Too many questions at once. Try again in a minute.';
const UNAVAILABLE = 'No answer right now. Try again in a moment.';
const LIMIT_UNNAMED = "You've used today's questions. They reset at midnight UTC.";

type AskPanelProps = { target: AskTarget };

type Failure = Extract<AskResult, { status: 'failed' }>;

type Answered = { answer: string; asked: string; limit: number; remaining: number };

function isFreeLimit(failure: Failure | null): boolean {
  return failure?.reason === 'limit' && failure.tier === 'free';
}

function describeFailure(failure: Failure): string {
  if (failure.reason === 'busy') return BUSY;
  if (failure.reason === 'unavailable') return UNAVAILABLE;
  if (failure.limit === undefined) return LIMIT_UNNAMED;
  if (failure.tier === 'free') {
    const proLine = failure.proLimit === undefined ? '' : ` Pro has ${failure.proLimit}.`;
    return `That is the free tier's ${failure.limit} for today.${proLine}`;
  }
  return `That is today's ${failure.limit}.`;
}

export function AskPanel({ target }: AskPanelProps) {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [isBusy, setIsBusy] = useState(false);
  const [answered, setAnswered] = useState<Answered | null>(null);
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<Failure | null>(null);
  const [isOfferOpen, setIsOfferOpen] = useState(false);
  const isMounted = useRef(true);
  const closeOffer = useCallback(() => setIsOfferOpen(false), []);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      isMounted.current = false;
    },
    [],
  );

  const trimmed = message.trim();
  const canSend = trimmed !== '' && !isBusy;

  async function send() {
    if (!canSend) return;
    setIsBusy(true);
    setFailure(null);
    const result = await requestAskAnswer(target, trimmed);
    if (!isMounted.current) return;
    setIsBusy(false);
    if (result.status === 'failed') {
      setFailure(result);
      return;
    }
    const { answer, limit, remaining } = result;
    setAnswered({ answer, asked: trimmed, limit, remaining });
    setMessage('');
  }

  return (
    <View className="mt-8 border-t border-line pt-6">
      <Text role="heading" aria-level={2} className="mb-3 font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-signal">
        Ask about this card
      </Text>
      <TextInput
        aria-label="Your question about this card"
        editable={!isBusy}
        maxLength={ASK_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH}
        multiline
        placeholder="Why is this the answer?"
        value={message}
        onChangeText={setMessage}
        className="min-h-[64px] border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm text-ink"
      />
      <Pressable
        role="button"
        aria-label="Ask"
        aria-disabled={!canSend}
        disabled={!canSend}
        onPress={() => void send()}
        className={`mt-3 self-start border border-ink px-4 py-2 ${canSend ? '' : 'opacity-50'}`}
      >
        <Text className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-ink">{isBusy ? 'Asking…' : 'Ask'}</Text>
      </Pressable>
      <View aria-live="polite">
        {failure ? <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-amber">{describeFailure(failure)}</Text> : null}
        {answered ? (
          <View className="mt-4">
            <Text className="mb-2 font-mono text-xs text-muted">{answered.asked}</Text>
            <Text className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink">{answered.answer}</Text>
            <Text className="mt-2 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-muted">
              {`${answered.remaining} of ${answered.limit} left today`}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {isFreeLimit(failure) ? (
        <Pressable
          role="button"
          aria-label="See Pro"
          onPress={() => setIsOfferOpen(true)}
          className="mt-3 self-start border border-ink px-4 py-2"
        >
          <Text className="font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-ink">See Pro</Text>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
      {isOfferOpen ? <ProOffer onClose={closeOffer} source="ask_limit" /> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```ts
// Shared values for the admin access tests: the routes the app calls, the one Pro entry GET and PUT
// admin/access answer with, and GET me with its pro object. Request ids and identities are built at
// run time.
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';

import type { FakeReply } from '../../state/__tests__/authTestSupport';

export const PROFILE_ROUTE = 'GET me';
export const ACCESS_ROUTE = 'GET admin/access';
export const ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE = 'PUT admin/access';
export const ACCESS_PATH = 'admin/access';

// The admin grant is a lifetime row with no expiry (server, area 3, Task 3.9).
export const PRO_LIFETIME = 'syntactical.pro.lifetime';

export const ADMIN_GRANT_NAME = /^Pro \(admin grant\)$/;
export const PURCHASED_NAME = /^Pro \(purchased\)$/;
export const NOT_AVAILABLE_TEXT = /not (available|found)/i;

export type GrantSource = 'admin' | 'purchase' | null;
export type ProEntry = { grantSource: GrantSource; isGranted: boolean; productId: string };

export function buildEntry(grantSource: GrantSource): ProEntry {
  return { grantSource, isGranted: grantSource !== null, productId: PRO_LIFETIME };
}

// GET me with the account facts, the pro object, and (when given) isAdmin.
export function meReply(email: string, options: { isAdmin?: boolean; isPro?: boolean } = {}): FakeReply {
  const { isAdmin, isPro = false } = options;
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = {
    dailyGoal: 20,
    dayStreak: 0,
    email,
    hasPassword: true,
    pro: isPro
      ? { expiresAt: null, isActive: true, product: 'lifetime' }
      : { expiresAt: null, isActive: false, product: null },
    timezone: 'UTC',
    xpToday: 0,
  };
  if (isAdmin !== undefined) data.isAdmin = isAdmin;
  return { status: 200, body: { data } };
}

// GET admin/access and PUT admin/access both answer with the one entry.
export function entryReply(entry: ProEntry): FakeReply {
  return { status: 200, body: { data: entry } };
}

// An admin/access reply carrying whatever data a test gives, well-formed or not.
export function rawEntryReply(data: unknown): FakeReply {
  return { status: 200, body: { data } };
}

export type BuiltError = { code: string; message: string; reply: FakeReply; requestId: string };

// An error envelope whose code, message, and request id must never reach the screen.
export function buildErrorReply(status: number, code: string, message: string): BuiltError {
  const requestId = `req-${randomBytes(6).toString('hex')}`;
  return { code, message, reply: { status, body: { error: { code, message, requestId } } }, requestId };
}

// A 201 sign-in reply carrying a session value and user id, as POST auth/sessions/password sends it.
export function sessionReply(identity: { sessionValue: string; userId: string }): FakeReply {
  return { status: 201, body: { data: { token: identity.sessionValue, userId: identity.userId } } };
}
```

```tsx
// The admin route, app/admin.tsx, on native. The real AdminScreen, AuthProvider, StatsProvider,
// query client, useProStatus, and apiFetch/apiPut run against a routed fetch stand-in:
// - an admin sees one h1 "Admin" and one switch, "Pro (admin grant)", checked when isGranted;
// - Pro bought through a store shows as "Pro (purchased)", checked and disabled;
// - a toggle sends one PUT admin/access { isGranted }, keeps the switch disabled while it is in
//   flight, and shows what the response says; a 400, 429, 503, or network failure puts the switch
//   back and shows one alert with no code, message, request id, or status;
// - a signed-in non-admin, and an admin the server answers 403, see "not available" with no switch
//   and send no PUT; a guest, or an admin who signs out, is sent to "/" with one router.replace;
// - after a toggle the user's Pro status (useProStatus) follows without a reload;
// - a malformed GET admin/access reply shows the load-failed state;
// - after admin A signs out and non-admin B signs in on the same query client, B sees no Admin
//   link and the not-available state, and sends no PUT.
// Identities, passwords, and request ids are built at run time.
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';

import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { QueryClientProvider, type QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react-native';

import { escapeForRegExp } from '../../components/auth/__tests__/passwordSettingsTestSupport';
import { setExpoExtra } from '../../config/expoConstantsMock';
import { createQueryClient } from '../../config/queryClient';
import { settle } from '../../config/settle';
import {
  AUTH_STORAGE_KEY,
  SESSION_TOKEN_KEY,
  buildIdentity,
  holdReply,
  installRoutedFetch,
  type FakeReply,
  type RouteReply,
  type SignInIdentity,
} from '../../state/__tests__/authTestSupport';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '../../state/AuthProvider';
import { ContentProvider } from '../../state/ContentProvider';
import { OwnedStatsProvider } from '../../state/OwnedStatsProvider';
import { useProStatus } from '../../state/useProStatus';
import AdminScreen from '../admin';
import SettingsScreen from '../settings';

import {
  ACCESS_PATH,
  ACCESS_ROUTE,
  ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE,
  ADMIN_GRANT_NAME,
  NOT_AVAILABLE_TEXT,
  PROFILE_ROUTE,
  PURCHASED_NAME,
  buildEntry,
  buildErrorReply,
  entryReply,
  meReply,
  rawEntryReply,
  sessionReply,
} from './adminAccessTestSupport';

setExpoExtra({ apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.syntactical.dev/v1/' });

jest.mock('expo-secure-store', () => {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  return {
    mockValues: values,
    getItemAsync: jest.fn((key: string) => Promise.resolve(values.get(key) ?? null)),
    setItemAsync: jest.fn((key: string, value: string) => {
      values.set(key, value);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }),
    deleteItemAsync: jest.fn((key: string) => {
      values.delete(key);
      return Promise.resolve();
    }),
  };
});

jest.mock('../../state/SyncProvider', () => ({
  useSync: () => ({
    cancelPass: () => undefined,
    isSyncing: false,
    isUploadCapReached: false,
    syncNow: () => Promise.resolve(true),
  }),
}));

const mockReplace = jest.fn();

jest.mock('expo-router', () =>
  require('../../config/buildExpoRouterMock').buildExpoRouterMock({
    replace: (...args: unknown[]) => mockReplace(...args),
    readParams: () => ({}),
  }),
);

type SecureStoreMock = { mockValues: Map<string, string> };
const secureStore = jest.requireMock('expo-secure-store') as SecureStoreMock;

type Element = ReturnType<typeof screen.getByRole>;

let queryClient: QueryClient;
const latestPro: { status: string } = { status: '' };

// Shows what useProStatus reads, so a test can see it follow an admin change.
function ProStatusProbe() {
  const state = useProStatus();
  latestPro.status = state.status === 'ready' ? (state.isPro ? 'pro' : 'free') : state.status;
  return null;
}

async function signIn(identity: SignInIdentity): Promise<void> {
  await AsyncStorage.setItem(
    AUTH_STORAGE_KEY,
    JSON.stringify({ knownUserIds: [identity.userId], userId: identity.userId }),
  );
  secureStore.mockValues.set(SESSION_TOKEN_KEY, identity.sessionValue);
}

async function renderAdmin(): Promise<void> {
  await render(
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <ContentProvider contentBaseUrl={null}>
        <AuthProvider>
          <OwnedStatsProvider>
            <AdminScreen />
            <ProStatusProbe />
          </OwnedStatsProvider>
        </AuthProvider>
      </ContentProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>,
  );
}

function readIsDisabled(element: Element): boolean {
  const { accessibilityState, disabled } = element.props as {
    accessibilityState?: { disabled?: boolean };
    disabled?: boolean;
  };
  return disabled === true || accessibilityState?.disabled === true || element.props['aria-disabled'] === true;
}

async function renderSignedInAdmin(routes: Record<string, RouteReply | RouteReply[]>, name = ADMIN_GRANT_NAME) {
  const identity = buildIdentity();
  const routed = installRoutedFetch({ [PROFILE_ROUTE]: meReply(identity.email, { isAdmin: true }), ...routes });
  await signIn(identity);
  await renderAdmin();
  await screen.findByRole('switch', { name });
  return { ...routed, identity };
}

function listAccessUpdates(requests: { method: string; path: string; body: unknown }[]) {
  return requests.filter(({ method, path }) => method === 'PUT' && path === ACCESS_PATH);
}

beforeEach(async () => {
  await AsyncStorage.clear();
  secureStore.mockValues.clear();
  queryClient = createQueryClient();
  latestPro.status = '';
  mockReplace.mockClear();
});

afterEach(async () => {
  await settle();
  queryClient.clear();
});

describe('admin route for an admin', () => {
  it('shows one h1 "Admin" and one switch, "Pro (admin grant)", unchecked and enabled with no grant', async () => {
    await renderSignedInAdmin({ [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry(null)) });
    const level1 = screen
      .getAllByRole('heading')
      .filter((heading) => (heading.props['aria-level'] ?? heading.props.accessibilityLevel) === 1);
    expect(level1).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(level1[0]).toHaveTextContent(/^Admin$/);
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('switch')).toHaveLength(1);
    const proSwitch = screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME });
    expect(proSwitch).not.toBeChecked();
    expect(readIsDisabled(proSwitch)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('checks the switch for an admin grant and leaves it enabled', async () => {
    await renderSignedInAdmin({ [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry('admin')) });
    const proSwitch = screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME });
    expect(proSwitch).toBeChecked();
    expect(readIsDisabled(proSwitch)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('shows store-bought Pro as "Pro (purchased)": checked and disabled', async () => {
    await renderSignedInAdmin({ [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry('purchase')) }, PURCHASED_NAME);
    const proSwitch = screen.getByRole('switch', { name: PURCHASED_NAME });
    expect(proSwitch).toBeChecked();
    expect(readIsDisabled(proSwitch)).toBe(true);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('draws the switch as a track and thumb hidden from assistive technology, still role switch', async () => {
    await renderSignedInAdmin({ [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry(null)) });
    const proSwitch = screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME });
    for (const testID of ['switch-track-off', 'switch-thumb-off']) {
      const part = within(proSwitch).getByTestId(testID, { includeHiddenElements: true });
      expect(part.props['aria-hidden']).toBe(true);
    }
    const track = within(proSwitch).getByTestId('switch-track-off', { includeHiddenElements: true });
    expect(track.props.importantForAccessibility).toBe('no-hide-descendants');
    expect(within(proSwitch).queryByTestId('switch-track-off')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('admin route toggles', () => {
  it('grants with one PUT { isGranted: true }, disabled while in flight, then checked', async () => {
    const held = holdReply();
    const { requests } = await renderSignedInAdmin({
      [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry(null)),
      [ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE]: held,
    });
    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(listAccessUpdates(requests)).toHaveLength(1));
    expect(readIsDisabled(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }))).toBe(true);
    expect(listAccessUpdates(requests)[0].body).toEqual({ isGranted: true });

    await act(async () => {
      held.release(entryReply(buildEntry('admin')) as FakeReply);
    });
    await waitFor(() => expect(readIsDisabled(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }))).toBe(false));
    expect(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME })).toBeChecked();
    await settle();
    expect(listAccessUpdates(requests)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('alert')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('revokes an admin grant with one PUT { isGranted: false }, then unchecked', async () => {
    const { requests } = await renderSignedInAdmin({
      [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry('admin')),
      [ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry(null)),
    });
    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME })).not.toBeChecked());
    await settle();
    expect(listAccessUpdates(requests).map(({ body }) => body)).toEqual([{ isGranted: false }]);
  });

  it('shows what the response says: a revoke answered as purchased becomes "Pro (purchased)", checked and disabled', async () => {
    await renderSignedInAdmin({
      [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry('admin')),
      [ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry('purchase')),
    });
    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }));
    const purchased = await screen.findByRole('switch', { name: PURCHASED_NAME });
    expect(purchased).toBeChecked();
    expect(readIsDisabled(purchased)).toBe(true);
  });

  const failures: { label: string; build: () => { reply: FakeReply; secrets: string[] } }[] = [
    {
      label: '400 INVALID_BODY',
      build: () => {
        const error = buildErrorReply(400, 'INVALID_BODY', 'Invalid request body');
        return { reply: error.reply, secrets: [error.code, error.message, error.requestId, '400'] };
      },
    },
    {
      label: '429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
      build: () => {
        const error = buildErrorReply(429, 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'Too many requests');
        return { reply: error.reply, secrets: [error.code, error.message, error.requestId, '429'] };
      },
    },
    {
      label: '503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE',
      build: () => {
        const error = buildErrorReply(503, 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Database unavailable');
        return { reply: error.reply, secrets: [error.code, error.message, error.requestId, '503'] };
      },
    },
    {
      label: 'a network failure',
      build: () => ({ reply: 'reject', secrets: ['Network request failed', 'TypeError'] }),
    },
    {
      label: 'a malformed 200',
      build: () => ({ reply: rawEntryReply({ isGranted: 'yes' }), secrets: ['yes'] }),
    },
  ];

  it.each(failures)('puts the switch back and shows one alert with no internal detail on $label', async ({ build }) => {
    const { reply, secrets } = build();
    const { requests } = await renderSignedInAdmin({
      [ACCESS_ROUTE]: entryReply(buildEntry(null)),
      [ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE]: reply,
    });
    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }));
    const alert = await screen.findByRole('alert');
    await waitFor(() => expect(readIsDisabled(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }))).toBe(false));
    await settle();
    expect(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME })).not.toBeChecked();
    expect(screen.getAllByRole('alert')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(listAccessUpdates(requests)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent(/\S/);
    for (const secret of secrets) expect(alert).not.toHaveTextContent(new RegExp(escapeForRegExp(secret)));
  });
});

describe('admin route keeps the Pro status current', () => {
  it('makes useProStatus read Pro after a grant and free after a revoke, without a reload', async () => {
    const identity = buildIdentity();
    const { setRoute } = installRoutedFetch({

    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME })).toBeChecked());
    await waitFor(() => expect(latestPro.status).toBe('pro'));

    // And once the revoke commits.
    setRoute(ACCESS_UPDATE_ROUTE, entryReply(buildEntry(null)));
    setRoute(PROFILE_ROUTE, meReply(identity.email, { isAdmin: true }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(readIsDisabled(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }))).toBe(false));
    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByRole('switch', { name: ADMIN_GRANT_NAME })).not.toBeChecked());
    await waitFor(() => expect(latestPro.status).toBe('free'));
  });
});

describe('admin route for anyone who is not an admin', () => {

    expect(screen.queryByText(NOT_AVAILABLE_TEXT)).toBeNull();
    expect(requests.some(({ method, path }) => method === 'GET' && path === ACCESS_PATH)).toBe(false);
    expect(listAccessUpdates(requests)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

    setRoute(PROFILE_ROUTE, meReply(memberB.email, { isAdmin: false }));

    const password = randomBytes(12).toString('hex');
    await act(async () => {

    await screen.findByLabelText('New password');

    await settle();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: 'Admin' })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryAllByRole('switch')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(listAccessUpdates(requests)).toHaveLength(0);
    const accessReads = requests.filter(({ method, path }) => method === 'GET' && path === ACCESS_PATH);
    expect(accessReads[accessReads.length - 1].headers.authorization).toContain(memberB.sessionValue);
  });
});
```
